Comments (English): [ Clean cleaning power and a neat appearance ] || ---------------- || First of all, the visible design and exterior are simple, and the ivory color looks luxurious and calm, making it a product that fits well in any space. Its compact size is also an advantage, allowing it to be installed even in small kitchens. Operation is not difficult, making it easy to use, and the interior is efficiently designed to store and wash a large number of kitchen dishes. Immediately after installation, I ran it on standard mode without detergent as a test with a few dishes and a kettle that were not heavily soiled but had some dust and grease stains. Seeing the stainless steel kettle come out spotless, I felt that the product was excellent. Regarding noise, if the sink countertop is made of stainless steel rather than artificial marble, the noise level is quite high. I installed it in my office pantry, and since the countertop is stainless steel, I found myself exposed to quite severe noise. As for the installation, I substituted the connection point of my existing water purifier with the dishwasher's water inlet (since I do not use a water purifier), so I found it puzzling that the product would have to be returned if that part was not prepared. When I asked for the reason, they stated that they do not possess other parts because they are subcontractors for the installation. However, if that is a prerequisite, they should have informed me in advance during the phone call to coordinate the installation date; it was disappointing that there was no notification regarding this prerequisite. Looking at other reviews, it seems they provide installation if the fee is paid, so I am puzzled as to why some people are saying it is not possible. To add another point of disappointment, the technician reeked of cigarette smoke. I usually try to be understanding, but I felt uncomfortable, wondering if the person providing the installation service was treating the customer disrespectfully. I believe that when meeting customers, one should at least be mindful of the foul smell of cigarettes as a matter of courtesy. Even if the product is excellent and satisfactory, the product's image can be devalued due to the installer's lack of basic professionalism; therefore, I believe appropriate training or measures should be taken regarding this issue. In summary, I will conclude by stating that while the product satisfaction is incomparably good, the installation service was disappointing.
Comments (Original): [ 깔끔한 세척력에 단정한 외관 ] || ---------------- || 우선 눈에 보이는 디자인이나 외관이 심플하고 아이보리 색상이 고급스럽고 차분해 보이며 어느 공간에 두더라도 잘 어울리는 제품이라 생각됩니다.  사이즈가 컴팩트하기에 좁은 주방 공간에도 살치할 수 있다는것 역시 장점이 되겠군요. 작동 역시 어렵지 않아 사용이 용이하며 세척기 내부가 많은 주방식기들을 수납,세척할 수 있도록 효율적으로 설계 구성되어 있어요.처음 설치하고 바로 오염이 심하지 않고 먼지와 약간의 기름때가 있는 몇개의 식기와 주전자를 시험용으로 세제없이 표준 모드로 작동시켜봤는데 스테인레스 주전자가 깔끔해지는것을 보고 제품이 우수함을 느꼈습니다.소음 부분은 씽크대 상판이 인조대리석 등으로 제작되지 않고 스테인리스로 제작된 씽크대라면 소음이 꽤 심합니다.저는 제 사무실 탕비실에 설치했는데 스테인리스 씽크대 상판이라 꽤 심한 소음에 노출됨을 알게 되었어요.설치 부분에 있어 저는 기존 정수기 연결 부분을 식기세척기의 물이 주입되는 부분으로 대처했는데 (정수기를 사용하지 않음)제품 설치 기사분께서 만약 그 부분이 준비되지 않았다면 제품이 반송되어야한다고 하시는 부분이 의아했어요.이유를 물으니 본인들은 하청받아 설치하기 때문에 다른 부품을 가지고 있지 않다고 했는데 만약 그 부분이 선결되어야 한다면  설치 일자 조율에 관한 전화 통화시 미리 알려주어야 하는 부분일텐데 어떤 선결 내용 고지도 없는것이 아쉬웠답니다.다른 분들의 상품평을 보니 설치비를 지불하면 설치해 준다고 하시는데 왜 안된다는 분들이 계시는지 의아합니다.또 한가지 아쉬운 점을 더 피력하자면 기사분이 담배냄새가 정말 심했습니다.웬만하면 저도 이해하는데 고객에게 설치 서비스를 제공하시는 분이 고객을 하잖게 생각하는것이 아닌가? 하는 불편감이 들었고 고객을 만날때엔 적어도 역한 담배냄새는 좀 조심해야하는것이 서로에 대한 매너가 아닐까 싶습니다.제품이 우수하고 만족스럽더라도 설치하시는 분의 기본적인 부분의 결여로 인하여 제품에 대한 이미지가 평가 절하될수도 있음에 이 부분에 관한 적절한 교육이나 조치가 이루어져야한다고 생각합니다.총평은 제품 만족도는 비할바 없이 좋지만 설치 서비스 부분이 아쉬웠다는것으로 마무리 하겠습니다.

Sentence (English): I had high hopes for this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ I had high hopes ] || ---------------- || I had high hopes for this dishwasher. After all, I paid a lot more for this than most competetive brands. WHAT I LIKE1) Quiet. Except for when I have very lightweight plasticware that I am cleaning or the washer arm is not rotating (my bad), it's extremely quiet.2) Cleans well.WHAT NEEDS IMPROVEMENT1) Needs indicator (other than app notification) of when cycle is finished. A multi-color LED would do the trick. As it is, there is an indicator light to show when the unit is running (not really needed as you can hear it, although it's not loud), but when the cycle is over there is no indication. Just doesn't make sense. This is a significant step backwards compared to my old KitchenAid dishwasher. A must-have.2) Utensil rack center piece comes loose or out when pulling rack out. I think in time it will loosen and not stay in at all. There's really not a good place to grab and pull. It's a little hard to describe - see attached photos. So. why is this designed this way? It's ridiculous and very unintuitive.

Sentence (English): I have had this machine for a few weeks now.
Comments (English): [ The second dishwasher worked. ] || ---------------- || I have had this machine for a few weeks now. After the first one proved to be defective the second one has been working properly. The pros: The dishes do get clean. The noise level is acceptable. Appearance is fine. Nice sturdy handle. The third rack is a nice asset. The cons: Odd layout of the racks requires tricky positioning. The door top digital controls are a little finicky and require a restart each time if door is opened with only four seconds between button push and door closure. The door itself must be pushed firmly all the way down each time it's opened. In conclusion, after having owned more than 10 dishwashers over the years I would say this one cleans as well as any I've encountered before. I am also convinced that with all of the high tech features that modern machines offer there is but very little difference in over all results. The dishes get cleaned. I don't think AI is necessary to achieve good results. This technology plus most of the others make for an attractive selling point in today's world. They also make for a higher selling price as well as providing additional ways for product breakdowns.

Sentence (English): This is a nice dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Good Dishwasher with Room for Improvement ] || ---------------- || This is a nice dishwasher. I do not regret the purchase; however, there is room for improvement. This review is all my personal opinion based on the dishwasher I own. Your personal experience may vary. This dishwasher does no better job of drying dishes than any other dishwasher I've owned. The 3rd row on top actually leaves anything up there quite wet even though I'm using the Crystal Dry setting on every cycle. The tines in the 2nd row where you normally put glasses are adjustible. Unfortunately, the clip that is supposed to hold the tines in place came warped and doesn't hold the tines up making it difficult to use the one side for glasses without the tines falling over. The door slams shut unless you open it up very far, much further than I've ever had to open a dishwasher door to get it to stay open. So that means that, unlike every other dishwasher I've owned, I have to hold it open with one hand and hit the cycles and start button with the other. Otherwise it will slam shut. Alternately, you can open the door up to the point where you have to bend over to get to the control panel and start it from there. It's not the best design for door springs in my opinion. Would I buy a Bosch again? Absolutely, but I would save the money and buy a 300 series or 500 series because this one wasn't worth the upcharge. It is a beautiful dishwasher in terms of appearance, and we really like the fingerprint-free finish. I don't regret the purchase, but it is not living up to my expectations.

Comments (English): [ Dishwasher is a new world ] || ---------------- || My husband's company says that young people always buy a dishwasher when they get married, and that it will be a whole new world once they use it, so he kept nagging me for years to buy a dishwasher. I thought it would be annoying to help with the dishes, and I thought that if I did it by hand, what's the point of washing dishes? I said no, but recently I've lost interest in housework, and there's nothing exciting going on. Since I work during the day, the housework that piled up in the evenings was burdensome, so my husband just ordered one. On the day of the installation, I grumbled to myself that there was more work to do for no reason and I was upset, but guess what? This dishwasher is the second best thing my husband has done in his life, next to letting me adopt a dog! ^^ The dryer and dehumidifier were both amazing, but oh my, after getting this, the dishes piling up on the sink are so exciting... *It's squeakier than when I did it by hand. *I even washed the oil-free dishes without detergent and I'm satisfied. *It takes about 1 hour and 30 minutes without sterilizing or drying, and it is the most routine method. *Even without sterilizing or drying, the inside gets hot after one cycle is over. That means the drying effect is sufficient. *No plastic is allowed. I just put it in as a demonstration. Do not use plastic tumblers, disposable containers, side dish lids, etc. They get warped. *While doing that, I realized that I secretly use a lot of plastic. I am going to gradually reduce it. *When it is finished****, the door opens slightly. So the heat is cooled down and it dries a little. I leave it wide open when I am finished, but it is nice to have it open**** when I go out. *When installing, the remaining part of the sink is made usable. So the installation cost was 130,000 won. There is an installation cost for built-in ones.

Sentence (English): I ordered a new dishwasher instead of the old one when I moved.
Comments (English): I ordered a new dishwasher instead of the old one when I moved. Brand-name dishwashers are good, but I mainly use them for the features I need, so rather than one with many functions, I just need something that cleans well and is basic. Since the moving cost is high and I might leave it behind again when I move, I chose a product with cost-effectiveness rather than an expensive one. The technicians came quickly. There were two of them, and one was learning. I was lucky that the one who came was very kind and thorough. They exposed one side of the sink and put it in tightly. They connected everything and checked for leaks and operation. They were very meticulous. It has two levels. You can put plates, bowls, spoons, and cups in and rotate them. The storage is large, but it lacks some levels or attention to detail. There are various modes, but I only use one. There is also a drying function. Washing is easy. When I rotated it, the washing was done well without any smell or water stains. The door opens automatically. The difference is that it is the old L. It dries a bit slower than I expected. The only downside is that it doesn't have any detailed storage and it can't be moved. Since it's on Coupang, that doesn't seem to be possible. I'm a bit worried about moving and installing it. I'm thinking of leaving it behind, though. In my opinion, it's a good value for money washer. I've been using it for about two months since I installed it, and it works well. There are no leaks, and I like it. I tend to buy things after reading comments, so I wrote this honestly. If you're considering it, I hope it was helpful.

Sentence (English): Cost-effective dishwasher.
Comments (English): Cost-effective dishwasher. I left the old model behind when I moved and ordered a new one. Brand-name dishwashers are nice, but I tend to use only the most basic functions, so I'm more interested in something that cleans well than something with a lot of features. Moving costs are high, and I might leave it behind again. I chose this product for its cost-effectiveness over something expensive. The technicians arrived quickly. Two technicians arrived, one of whom was still learning. I was lucky to have a very kind and thorough technician. He exposed one side of the sink, and it was a tight fit. He connected everything, checked for leaks, and checked operation. He was very meticulous. It has two tiers. You can put in plates, bowls, spoons, and cups, and rotate them. The storage is spacious, but it lacks some of the tiers and attention to detail. It has various modes, but I only use one. There's also a drying function. Washing is easy. I tried it on, and it was washed well, without any odor or stains. The door opens automatically. The difference is... It dries a bit slowly. The only downside is that there's no detailed storage. It can't be moved. Since it's on Coupang, that seems a bit out of the question. Moving and re-installation are a bit concerning. I'm thinking of leaving it behind, though. As far as I'm concerned, it's a good value dishwasher. I've been using it for about two months since installing it. It works well. There are no leaks. I like it. I tend to buy after reading the comments, so I wrote this honestly. If you're considering it, I hope it's of some help.

Sentence (English): I had high hopes for this dishwasher.
Comments (English): I had high hopes for this dishwasher. After all, I paid a lot more for this than most competetive brands. WHAT I LIKE. 1) Quiet. Except for when I have very lightweight plasticware that I am cleaning or the washer arm is not rotating (my bad), it's extremely quiet. 2) Cleans well. WHAT NEEDS IMPROVEMENT. 1) Needs indicator (other than app notification) of when cycle is finished. A multi-color LED would do the trick. As it is, there is an indicator light to show when the unit is running (not really needed as you can hear it, although it's not loud), but when the cycle is over there is no indication. Just doesn't make sense. This is a significant step backwards compared to my old KitchenAid dishwasher. A must-have. 2) Utensil rack center piece comes loose or out when pulling rack out. I think in time it will loosen and not stay in at all. There's really not a good place to grab and pull. It's a little hard to describe - see attached photos. So. why is this designed this way? It's ridiculous and very unintuitive.

Comments (English): [ Slightly disappointed. ] || ---------------- || Our Bosch dishwasher is a series 800 with a wood panel. We have had our Bosch for less than a month when the machine wouldn't drain. First service call. Second service call for the rubber piece at the front bottom of the dishwasher was covering up the red light for the floor to indicate that the cycle is finished. A new rubber piece is on order, so we'll see if that corrects the problem. On the positive side, the dishwasher is very quiet and really throughly cleans the dishes. I do like the 3rd drawer in the top for the silverware. I didn't think I would like it, but it makes it easier to gather up the silverware to put away. I wish there was a video of how to load the dishes in detail--which way they should face and where to put each size dishes. All dishwashers are different and load differently. The dishwasher I had before was a 13 year old panel ready GE Profile.

Sentence (English): Our 4-year, 10-month old Samsung dishwasher failed just before the extended warranty expired and the insurance company opted to return our money rather than fix it.
Comments (English): [ Never Had Dishes So Clean ] || ---------------- || Our 4-year, 10-month old Samsung dishwasher failed just before the extended warranty expired and the insurance company opted to return our money rather than fix it. I decided to go with a Bosch based on Consumer Reports and after a lot of comparison shopping, settled on this unit. It was more than I wanted to spend, but I had $500 from the insurance company and Costco had a good deal with warranty and delivery. With the old Samsung, I'd often ask my wife if the dishwasher was clean. I couldn't really tell by looking at the dishes because they still looked kind of grungy. I'd have to look for pools of water on some of the cocave parts of glasses and bowls to be certain the dishwasher ran. With the Bosch, when I open up the dishwasher everything is clearly clean. No hint of food stuck on plates and the glasses sparkle (rinse aid helps for certain, but the Bosch does much better with it than the Samsung). Yes, it cost a lot more than my old Samsung. Also, Installation isn't simple because it has a special plug, so you either need the optional hardwire kit (which I found for $20 locally) or have an outlet for your dishwasher. The water connection hose took a bigger hole in the cabinet to get through to the sink because it has a shutoff mechanism that prevents flooding your kitchen floor. These modifications weren't necessary hard, but you have to be handy with tools to do them. Certainly not something my 78 mother would be able to do. Costco included installation but cabinet modifications would have been extra and I just went ahead and did the installation myself after doing all the modifications. So far I'm very pleased with the dishwasher. It's terribly quiet. Thankfully it has a cool red square-shaped light that shines on the floor when running otherwise I might not know. My wife likes the mobile app and that's how she programs it to finish right before I get up so my coffee mug is still warn from the drying cycle. I've only had it running for a bit over a month now, but I have no complaints and recommend this unit.

Sentence (English): I'm very satisfied with the dishwasher overall, so I'd like to share my experience in more detail!
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I'm very satisfied with the dishwasher overall, so I'd like to share my experience in more detail! Design and Size: I initially chose this product because it's space-saving. Because my kitchen is small, I wasn't considering a larger dishwasher, but this 6-seater model is just the right size and has a clean, modern design. The exterior blends well with my kitchen, and its compact size means it doesn't take up much space, making it convenient even in a small kitchen. For me, it's perfect for one or two people. However, I felt a 6-seater might be a bit too small for a larger family. Washing Performance: I'm very satisfied with the washing performance. Even with the basic wash program, dishes are thoroughly cleaned, with almost no food residue. In particular, everyday items like plates, cutlery, and cups are always cleaned without worry, just by loading them in and running. The powerful wash mode almost completely removes any grease or stains, which is a distinct difference from other models. Noise and Efficiency: The noise level is surprisingly low. It was quiet during the wash, so it didn't bother me much while I was doing other things in the kitchen or watching TV in the living room. This could be a huge advantage for those sensitive to noise from the dishwasher. It's also quite energy efficient. My electricity bill didn't increase significantly after washing, and water consumption seemed to be efficiently controlled, minimizing the financial burden. Washing Time: Washing time varies depending on the program, but a basic wash takes about an hour. This time is sufficient for my busy schedule, and I was satisfied with it. However, if you choose a program with a longer wash time (such as a heavy wash), you should consider that it will take a little longer. Capacity: This is a 6-person dishwasher, so it can handle a reasonable amount of laundry at a time. While it's sufficient for a one- or two-person household, you may need to split the load up if you have a large group of friends or family. In my case, as a two-person household, I can handle most of the dishes in one wash, but for a large family, it might be inconvenient when the load is large. Conclusion: This 6-person dishwasher is space-saving and offers excellent cleaning power, efficiency, and noise reduction. It's especially suitable for small households or single- or two-person households, and it would also be useful in homes with limited space. Nevertheless, I'm overall satisfied with it. Capacity: This is a 6-person dishwasher, so it can handle a reasonable amount of laundry at a time. While it's sufficient for a one- or two-person household, you may need to split the load up if you have a large group of friends or family. Conclusion: This 6-person dishwasher is space-saving and offers excellent cleaning power, efficiency, and noise reduction. Capacity: This is a 6-person dishwasher, so it can handle a reasonable amount of laundry at a time. While it's sufficient for a one- or two-person household, you may need to split the load up if you have a large group of friends or family. Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. Because my kitchen is small, I wasn't considering a larger dishwasher, but this 6-seater model is just the right size and has a clean, modern design. The exterior blends well with my kitchen, and its compact size means it doesn't take up much space, making it convenient even in a small kitchen. For me, it's perfect for one or two people. It was quiet during the wash cycle, so I didn't have to worry about it while doing other things in the kitchen or watching TV in the living room. This could be a huge advantage for those sensitive to dishwasher noise. It's also quite energy efficient. My electricity bill didn't increase significantly after washing, and water consumption seemed to be efficiently controlled, minimizing the financial burden. Washing time. Washing time varies depending on the program, but a basic wash takes about an hour. This time is sufficient for efficient use even during a busy day, which I was satisfied with. However, if you choose a program with a longer wash time (such as a heavy wash), you should consider that it will take a little longer. Capacity. As a six-person dishwasher, it has a reasonable capacity for one load. While it's sufficient for a one- or two-person household, you may need to split the load up if you have a large group of friends or family. In my case, as a two-person household, I can handle most of the dishes in one go, but for a large family, it might be inconvenient when the load is large. Conclusion. The six-person dishwasher is space-saving while also offering excellent cleaning power, efficiency, and noise reduction. Sentence (English): I'm very satisfied with the washing performance.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I'm very satisfied with the dishwasher overall, so I'd like to share my experience in more detail! Design and Size. The first reason I chose this product was its space-saving design. Because my kitchen is small, I wasn't considering a larger dishwasher, but this 6-seater model is just the right size and has a clean, modern design. The exterior blends well with my kitchen, and its compact size means it doesn't take up much space, making it convenient even in a small kitchen. For me, it's perfect for one or two people. However, I felt a 6-seater might be a bit too small for a larger family. Washing Performance. I'm very satisfied with the washing performance. Even with the basic wash program, dishes are thoroughly cleaned, with almost no food residue. In particular, everyday items like plates, cutlery, and cups are always cleaned without worry, just by loading them in and running. The powerful wash mode almost completely removes any grease or stains, which is a clear difference from other models. Noise and Efficiency. It's much quieter than I expected. It was quiet during the wash cycle, so I didn't have to worry about it while doing other things in the kitchen or watching TV in the living room. This could be a huge advantage for those sensitive to dishwasher noise. It's also quite energy efficient. My electricity bill didn't increase significantly after washing, and water consumption seemed to be efficiently controlled, minimizing the financial burden. Washing time. Washing time varies depending on the program, but a basic wash takes about an hour. This time is sufficient for efficient use even during a busy day, which I was satisfied with. However, if you choose a program with a longer wash time (such as a heavy wash), you should consider that it will take a little longer. Capacity. As a six-person dishwasher, it has a reasonable capacity for one load. While it's sufficient for a one- or two-person household, you may need to split the load up if you have a large group of friends or family. In my case, as a two-person household, I can handle most of the dishes in one go, but for a large family, it might be inconvenient when the load is large. Conclusion. The six-person dishwasher is space-saving while also offering excellent cleaning power, efficiency, and noise reduction. It's especially suitable for small households or one- or two-person households, and it would also be useful in homes with limited space. Nevertheless, I'm overall satisfied with it. Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I'm very satisfied with the dishwasher overall, so I'd like to share my experience in more detail! Design and Size. The first reason I chose this product was its space-saving design. Because my kitchen is small, I wasn't considering a larger dishwasher, but this 6-seater model is just the right size and has a clean, modern design. The exterior blends well with my kitchen, and its compact size means it doesn't take up much space, making it convenient even in a small kitchen. For me, it's perfect for one or two people. However, I felt a 6-seater might be a bit too small for a larger family. Washing Performance. I'm very satisfied with the washing performance. Even with the basic wash program, dishes are thoroughly cleaned, with almost no food residue. The powerful wash mode almost completely removes any grease or stains, which is a clear difference from other models. Noise and Efficiency. It's much quieter than I expected. It was quiet during the wash cycle, so I didn't have to worry about it while doing other things in the kitchen or watching TV in the living room. This could be a huge advantage for those sensitive to dishwasher noise. It's also quite energy efficient. My electricity bill didn't increase significantly after washing, and water consumption seemed to be efficiently controlled, minimizing the financial burden. Washing time. Washing time varies depending on the program, but a basic wash takes about an hour. This time is sufficient for efficient use even during a busy day, which I was satisfied with. However, if you choose a program with a longer wash time (such as a heavy wash), you should consider that it will take a little longer. Capacity. As a six-person dishwasher, it has a reasonable capacity for one load. While it's sufficient for a one- or two-person household, you may need to split the load up if you have a large group of friends or family. In my case, as a two-person household, I can handle most of the dishes in one go, but for a large family, it might be inconvenient when the load is large. Conclusion. The six-person dishwasher is space-saving while also offering excellent cleaning power, efficiency, and noise reduction. It's especially suitable for small households or one- or two-person households, and it would also be useful in homes with limited space. Nevertheless, I'm overall satisfied with it. Sentence (English): The six-person dishwasher is space-saving while also offering excellent cleaning power, efficiency, and noise reduction.
Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I'm very satisfied with the dishwasher overall, so I'd like to share my experience in more detail! Design and Size. The first reason I chose this product was its space-saving design. Because my kitchen is small, I wasn't considering a larger dishwasher, but this 6-seater model is just the right size and has a clean, modern design. The exterior blends well with my kitchen, and its compact size means it doesn't take up much space, making it convenient even in a small kitchen. For me, it's perfect for one or two people. However, I felt a 6-seater might be a bit too small for a larger family. Washing Performance. I'm very satisfied with the washing performance. Even with the basic wash program, dishes are thoroughly cleaned, with almost no food residue. In particular, everyday items like plates, cutlery, and cups are always cleaned without worry, just by loading them in and running. The powerful wash mode almost completely removes any grease or stains, which is a clear difference from other models. Noise and Efficiency. It's much quieter than I expected. It was quiet during the wash cycle, so I didn't have to worry about it while doing other things in the kitchen or watching TV in the living room. This could be a huge advantage for those sensitive to dishwasher noise. It's also quite energy efficient. My electricity bill didn't increase significantly after washing, and water consumption seemed to be efficiently controlled, minimizing the financial burden. Washing time. Washing time varies depending on the program, but a basic wash takes about an hour. This time is sufficient for efficient use even during a busy day, which I was satisfied with. However, if you choose a program with a longer wash time (such as a heavy wash), you should consider that it will take a little longer. Capacity. As a six-person dishwasher, it has a reasonable capacity for one load. While it's sufficient for a one- or two-person household, you may need to split the load up if you have a large group of friends or family. In my case, as a two-person household, I can handle most of the dishes in one go, but for a large family, it might be inconvenient when the load is large. Conclusion. The six-person dishwasher is space-saving while also offering excellent cleaning power, efficiency, and noise reduction. It's especially suitable for small households or one- or two-person households, and it would also be useful in homes with limited space. Nevertheless, I'm overall satisfied with it. If you have a large family, you might want to consider a larger capacity model, but I'm very satisfied with it. Thank you for reading my lengthy review. However, if you choose a program with a longer wash time (such as a heavy wash), you should consider that it will take a little longer. Capacity. As a six-person dishwasher, it has a reasonable capacity for one load. While it's sufficient for a one- or two-person household, you may need to split the load up if you have a large group of friends or family. Sentence (English): Great Dishwasher and upgrade to our old one!
Comments (English): [ Awesome, Quiet Dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || Great Dishwasher and upgrade to our old one! The dishwasher fit perfectly in the space where our previous dishwasher was, with no issues. This dishwasher comes with three racks, which is efficient in washing everything at once. The dishwasher we have comes with the bar handle, which we like. Although the display is hidden by the countertop, it is good knowing the dishwasher can be stopped and restarted, should you need to reopen it. As there are only two of us, we do not have to fill the dishwasher with a ton of dishes and have had no issues with its overall performance. This dishwasher is wonderful and brings enthusiasm back to washing dishes!

Spent over 4 hours going from one 800 number to another, sent to websites with dead links, and finally to their "authorized" repair service that no longer repairs their products. Now we start fresh with a repair service weeks away. The top touchpad does not respond correctly and the dishwasher does not drain. Bosch will not replace the dishwasher but wants to try to replace parts first. If you want a $1,000 dishwasher that does not wash dishes and has horrible customer service then Bosch is for you.

Sentence (English): I am delighted.
Comments (English): [ Great for saving and perfect for cleaning ] || ---------------- || I am delighted. I am using it in ECO mode, accumulating dishes for several days to fill it completely. It left everything clean, the door opens at the end and continues counting down the time, 1 hour I think, and everything is dry. I remove the remains of food from the dishes with the cutlery and napkin, but I do not rinse with water, soap, or brush it, or anything, since that is not saving water, soap or time. I accumulated dishes for 3 days, so I had cups with dried cocoa, dried coffee, dried lids with grease from spaghetti with bacon, dried pans from cooking meat, a lid completely covered in oil from storing tuna, everything came out clean. It is very important to add rinse aid and adjust the water hardness for the salt, so that the pipes and propellers do not deteriorate with lime. I used a branded 3-in-1 capsule and I will try the classic tablets and the powder too, to see if there is a difference in the wash. I put the dishwasher on during the cheapest hours, since it can be programmed.
Comments (Original): [ Genial para ahorrar y perfecto en limpieza ] || ---------------- || Estoy encantada. Lo estoy usando en modo ECO acumulando vajilla varios días para llenarlo por completo. Dejó todo limpio, la puerta se abre al final y sigue contando el tiempo hacia atrás 1h, creo y se queda todo seco. Elimino los restos de comida de la vajilla con los cubiertos y servilleta, pero no enjuago con agua, ni jabón, ni le paso un cepillo, ni nada, ya que eso no es ahorrar agua, ni jabón, ni tiempo. Acumulé vajilla 3 días, así que tenía tazas con cola-cao reseco, café reseco, tapes resecos con grasa de espaguetis con Bacon, sartenes resecas de hacer carne, un tape pringado entero de aceite de haber guardado atún, todo salió limpio. Importantísimo añadir abrillantador y ajustar la dureza del agua para la sal, para que no se deterioren los conductos y hélices con la cal. Utilicé un capsula 3 en 1 de marca y probaré las pastillas clásicas y el polvo también, para ver si hay diferencian en el lavado. Pongo el lavavajillas en las horas más baratas, ya que se puede programar.

Sentence (English): I'm delighted.
Comments (English): [ Great for saving and perfect for cleaning ] || ---------------- || I'm delighted. I've been using it in ECO mode, accumulating dishes for several days to completely fill it. It left everything clean. The door opens at the end and continues counting down, I think, by an hour, and everything stays dry. I remove food scraps from the dishes with cutlery and a napkin, but I don't rinse with water, soap, or brush them, or anything, since that doesn't save water, soap, or time. I accumulated dishes for three days, so I had cups with dried-up Coca-Cola, dried-up coffee, lids dried with bacon spaghetti grease, pans dried out from cooking meat, and a whole lid covered in oil from storing tuna. Everything came out clean. It's extremely important to add rinse aid and adjust the water hardness for the salt, so that the pipes and impellers don't deteriorate with limescale. I used a brand-name 3-in-1 capsule and will try the classic tablets and the powder as well, to see if there's a difference in the wash. I run the dishwasher at the cheapest times, since it can be programmed.
Comments (Original): [ Genial para ahorrar y perfecto en limpieza ] || ---------------- || Estoy encantada. Lo estoy usando en modo ECO acumulando vajilla varios días para llenarlo por completo. Dejó todo limpio, la puerta se abre al final y sigue contando el tiempo hacia atrás 1h, creo y se queda todo seco. Elimino los restos de comida de la vajilla con los cubiertos y servilleta, pero no enjuago con agua, ni jabón, ni le paso un cepillo, ni nada, ya que eso no es ahorrar agua, ni jabón, ni tiempo. Acumulé vajilla 3 días, así que tenía tazas con cola-cao reseco, café reseco, tapes resecos con grasa de espaguetis con Bacon, sartenes resecas de hacer carne, un tape pringado entero de aceite de haber guardado atún, todo salió limpio. Importantísimo añadir abrillantador y ajustar la dureza del agua para la sal, para que no se deterioren los conductos y hélices con la cal. Utilicé un capsula 3 en 1 de marca y probaré las pastillas clásicas y el polvo también, para ver si hay diferencian en el lavado. Pongo el lavavajillas en las horas más baratas, ya que se puede programar.

Sentence (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): This is a review written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've always wanted to try a dishwasher, and I finally got to! Nothing is more annoying than washing dishes, but this dishwasher was a whole new world! First of all, it seats 6 people, so in my case, we're a newlywed couple, so we don't have a lot of dishes, but we use them often, so we had to wash them often, and it held plenty, which was great! Also, when I was just washing dishes, I couldn't control the amount of detergent, so I always pumped a lot, and although they washed cleanly, I ended up using the detergent too quickly, but with this one, I just put in one solid detergent and turn it on, so it's so convenient and great. Also, it has a wide washing blade so you can wash in all directions and it dries at high temperature. I usually spin my glassware, but when I just wash dishes, there was a slight fishy smell from the dishes sometimes, but it caught it all and I think I was able to use it cleanly. And when it's finished, the door opens automatically so that the heat generated during the high-temperature drying escapes well, so on a day when I'm tired after work, I can just quickly put the larvae in and go to sleep. It's so great. Why, after using the dishwasher once, I understood why I couldn't live without it. The design of the dishwasher is pretty, so I chose the ivory color, and it doesn't spoil the interior at all and I use it by placing it next to the sink. However, when installing it for the first time, a hole is needed for water to come in. Fortunately, the previous owner of my house already had a hole drilled, so I didn't have to drill another one. However, they said that if it's needed, they'll have to drill one, so there may be a small installation fee. Also, the size is bigger than I thought, so I don't really care, but if you want a perfect fit, it might be a good idea to buy the size in stock. Oh, the dishwasher seems really great. I haven't used it because I heard that it can be linked to an app, but I think it will be very convenient when I have to leave the house.

First of all, it seats 6 people, so in my case, we're a newlywed couple, so we don't have a lot of dishes, but we use them often, so we had to wash them often, and it held plenty, which was great! Also, when I was just washing dishes, I couldn't control the amount of detergent, so I always pumped a lot, and although they washed cleanly, I ended up using the detergent too quickly, but with this one, I just put in one solid detergent and turn it on, so it's so convenient and great. Also, it has a wide washing blade so you can wash in all directions and it dries at high temperature. I usually spin my glassware, but when I just wash dishes, there was a slight fishy smell from the dishes sometimes, but it caught it all and I think I was able to use it cleanly. And when it's finished, the door opens automatically so that the heat generated during the high-temperature drying escapes well, so on a day when I'm tired after work, I can just quickly put the larvae in and go to sleep. It's so great. Why, after using the dishwasher once, I understood why I couldn't live without it. The design of the dishwasher is pretty, so I chose the ivory color, and it doesn't spoil the interior at all and I use it by placing it next to the sink. However, when installing it for the first time, a hole is needed for water to come in. Fortunately, the previous owner of my house already had a hole drilled, so I didn't have to drill another one. However, they said that if it's needed, they'll have to drill one, so there may be a small installation fee. Also, the size is bigger than I thought, so I don't really care, but if you want a perfect fit, it might be a good idea to buy the size in stock. Oh, the dishwasher seems really great. I haven't used it because I heard that it can be linked to an app, but I think it will be very convenient when I have to leave the house.

I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks and am leaving a review. After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual and asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It still works great! Design: I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is important, but if the size and features are similar, I tend to choose the one with the prettiest design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory, and I chose the clean and crisp white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handles are the highlight! It goes so well with my kitchen. The white countertop and wooden door match perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add some flair, and it's still going strong. The cleaning power: "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Will it be okay?" I worried for nothing. Simply put, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes away even the grease. I was so happy to see that even the food on the kids' dishes was washed clean. Various functions - Standard (70 minutes) - Auto (85-130 minutes) - Power (80 minutes) - High-temperature wash (86 minutes) - Rapid (35 minutes) - Various courses are designed to suit your needs, which is convenient. You can choose a course based on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes. Convenience - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially confused by people bringing in dishes during the wash cycle, but the additional function was nice. - The automatic door open function was also really great. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report, and the door would automatically open after the dishwasher was finished, ensuring the dishwasher was still dry. - It says you can connect it to the Media Smart Home app, but I wonder if I'll really use it? I had that thought~ But just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and surprisingly, I ended up using it quite often~ My kids, who aren't very good at operating the dishwasher, or people at home just put their dishes in the dishwasher, and I could start it from outside. By the time I came home from work, ta-da! The dishes were done! Noise: Although this appliance is bound to be noisy, I didn't find it bothersome. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or going out, and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! Design: I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is important, but if the size and features are similar, I tend to choose the one with the prettiest design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory, and I chose the clean and crisp white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handles are the highlight! It goes so well with my kitchen. The white countertop and wooden door match perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add some flair, and it's still going strong. The cleaning power: "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Will it be okay?" I worried for nothing. Simply put, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes away even the grease. I was so happy to see that even the food on the kids' dishes was washed clean. Various functions - Standard (70 minutes) - Auto (85-130 minutes) - Power (80 minutes) - High-temperature wash (86 minutes) - Rapid (35 minutes) - Various courses are designed to suit your needs, which is convenient. You can choose a course based on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes. Convenience - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially confused by people bringing in dishes during the wash cycle, but the additional function was nice. - The automatic door open function was also really great. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report, and the door would automatically open after the dishwasher was finished, ensuring the dishwasher was still dry. - It says you can connect it to the Media Smart Home app, but I wonder if I'll really use it? I had that thought~ But just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and surprisingly, I ended up using it quite often~ My kids, who aren't very good at operating the dishwasher, or people at home just put their dishes in the dishwasher, and I could start it from outside. By the time I came home from work, ta-da! The dishes were done! Noise: Although this appliance is bound to be noisy, I didn't find it bothersome. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or going out, and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! I can even register it with Coupang and get it repaired~ It's so convenient, worry-free, and the best service. Overall Media: The dishwasher is my right-hand man! After work, I don't have enough time to see my kids, and I always feel like I don't have time to check on their homework, make eye contact, talk, and play because I'm always busy eating, washing dishes, and cleaning up. After meeting this kid, Media Dishwasher, I'm so glad I can have a leisurely evening with my kids! And it seems to use less water than when I wash dishes with the water running. And most of all, because the dishes are washed well, it protects my wrinkled and aging hands. And because I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I usually use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that too, which was great! Since it's a six-person dishwasher, it easily handles the dishes used by a family of four, so it's spacious enough. It even has enough room for guests! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. Design: I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is important, but if the size and features are similar, I tend to choose the one with the prettiest design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory, and I chose the clean and crisp white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handles are the highlight! It goes so well with my kitchen. The white countertop and wooden door match perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add some flair, and it's still going strong. The cleaning power: "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Will it be okay?" I worried for nothing. Simply put, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes away even the grease. I was so happy to see that even the food on the kids' dishes was washed clean. Various functions - Standard (70 minutes) - Auto (85-130 minutes) - Power (80 minutes) - High-temperature wash (86 minutes) - Rapid (35 minutes) - Various courses are designed to suit your needs, which is convenient. You can choose a course based on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes. Convenience - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially confused by people bringing in dishes during the wash cycle, but the additional function was nice. - The automatic door open function was also really great. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report, and the door would automatically open after the dishwasher was finished, ensuring the dishwasher was still dry. - It says you can connect it to the Media Smart Home app, but I wonder if I'll really use it? I had that thought~ But just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and surprisingly, I ended up using it quite often~ My kids, who aren't very good at operating the dishwasher, or people at home just put their dishes in the dishwasher, and I could start it from outside. By the time I came home from work, ta-da! The dishes were done! Noise: Although this appliance is bound to be noisy, I didn't find it bothersome. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or going out, and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! I can even register it with Coupang and get it repaired~ It's so convenient, worry-free, and the best service. Overall Media: The dishwasher is my right-hand man! After work, I don't have enough time to see my kids, and I always feel like I don't have time to check on their homework, make eye contact, talk, and play because I'm always busy eating, washing dishes, and cleaning up. After meeting this kid, Media Dishwasher, I'm so glad I can have a leisurely evening with my kids! And it seems to use less water than when I wash dishes with the water running. And most of all, because the dishes are washed well, it protects my wrinkled and aging hands. And because I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I usually use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that too, which was great! Since it's a six-person dishwasher, it easily handles the dishes used by a family of four, so it's spacious enough. It even has enough room for guests! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! Comments (English): [ My new right arm ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks and am leaving a review. I think I run it about twice a day, morning and evening, and I intentionally used it continuously in the beginning.^^----------------------------------------------------------------------------------[Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Open 6-Person Dishwasher] Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM Components: Body + Basket + Cutlery Holder---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Rocket Installation - The technician came to install the product the very next day. They called me early in the morning so I could coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation is really great because you can schedule delivery on any date you want within two weeks of purchase! - The technician installed it very skillfully, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink already had a hole in the top for the water purifier, so I didn't have to drill a separate hole and just ran the hose through the same place. After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual and asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It still works great! Design: I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is important, but if the size and features are similar, I tend to choose the one with the prettiest design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory, and I chose the clean and crisp white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handles are the highlight! It goes so well with my kitchen. The white countertop and wooden door match perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add some flair, and it's still going strong. The cleaning power: "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Will it be okay?" I worried for nothing. Simply put, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes away even the grease. I was so happy to see that even the food on the kids' dishes was washed clean. Various functions - Standard (70 minutes) - Auto (85-130 minutes) - Power (80 minutes) - High-temperature wash (86 minutes) - Rapid (35 minutes) - Various courses are designed to suit your needs, which is convenient. You can choose a course based on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes. Convenience - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially confused by people bringing in dishes during the wash cycle, but the additional function was nice. - The automatic door open function was also really great. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report, and the door would automatically open after the dishwasher was finished, ensuring the dishwasher was still dry. - It says you can connect it to the Media Smart Home app, but I wonder if I'll really use it? I had that thought~ But just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and surprisingly, I ended up using it quite often~ My kids, who aren't very good at operating the dishwasher, or people at home just put their dishes in the dishwasher, and I could start it from outside. By the time I came home from work, ta-da! The dishes were done! Noise: Although this appliance is bound to be noisy, I didn't find it bothersome. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or going out, and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! I can even register it with Coupang and get it repaired~ It's so convenient, worry-free, and the best service. Overall Media: The dishwasher is my right-hand man! After work, I don't have enough time to see my kids, and I always feel like I don't have time to check on their homework, make eye contact, talk, and play because I'm always busy eating, washing dishes, and cleaning up. After meeting this kid, Media Dishwasher, I'm so glad I can have a leisurely evening with my kids! And it seems to use less water than when I wash dishes with the water running. And most of all, because the dishes are washed well, it protects my wrinkled and aging hands. And because I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I usually use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that too, which was great! Since it's a six-person dishwasher, it easily handles the dishes used by a family of four, so it's spacious enough. It even has enough room for guests! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. Functionality is important, but if the size and features are similar, I tend to choose the one with the prettiest design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. I worried for nothing. Simply put, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes away even the grease. I was so happy to see that even the food on the kids' dishes was washed clean. You can choose a course based on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes. Convenience - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially confused by people bringing in dishes during the wash cycle, but the additional function was nice. - The automatic door open function was also really great. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report, and the door would automatically open after the dishwasher was finished, ensuring the dishwasher was still dry. - It says you can connect it to the Media Smart Home app, but I wonder if I'll really use it? I had that thought~ But just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and surprisingly, I ended up using it quite often~ My kids, who aren't very good at operating the dishwasher, or people at home just put their dishes in the dishwasher, and I could start it from outside. By the time I came home from work, ta-da! The dishes were done! Noise: Although this appliance is bound to be noisy, I didn't find it bothersome. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or going out, and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! I can even register it with Coupang and get it repaired~ It's so convenient, worry-free, and the best service. Overall Media: The dishwasher is my right-hand man! After work, I don't have enough time to see my kids, and I always feel like I don't have time to check on their homework, make eye contact, talk, and play because I'm always busy eating, washing dishes, and cleaning up. After meeting this kid, Media Dishwasher, I'm so glad I can have a leisurely evening with my kids! And it seems to use less water than when I wash dishes with the water running. And most of all, because the dishes are washed well, it protects my wrinkled and aging hands. And because I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I usually use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that too, which was great! Since it's a six-person dishwasher, it easily handles the dishes used by a family of four, so it's spacious enough. It even has enough room for guests! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. Functionality is important, but if the size and features are similar, I tend to choose the one with the prettiest design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. I worried for nothing. Simply put, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes away even the grease. I was so happy to see that even the food on the kids' dishes was washed clean. You can choose a course based on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes. Convenience - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially confused by people bringing in dishes during the wash cycle, but the additional function was nice. - The automatic door open function was also really great. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report, and the door would automatically open after the dishwasher was finished, ensuring the dishwasher was still dry. - It says you can connect it to the Media Smart Home app, but I wonder if I'll really use it? I had that thought~ But just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and surprisingly, I ended up using it quite often~ My kids, who aren't very good at operating the dishwasher, or people at home just put their dishes in the dishwasher, and I could start it from outside. By the time I came home from work, ta-da! The dishes were done! Noise: Although this appliance is bound to be noisy, I didn't find it bothersome. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or going out, and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! I can even register it with Coupang and get it repaired~ It's so convenient, worry-free, and the best service. Overall Media: The dishwasher is my right-hand man! After work, I don't have enough time to see my kids, and I always feel like I don't have time to check on their homework, make eye contact, talk, and play because I'm always busy eating, washing dishes, and cleaning up. After meeting this kid, Media Dishwasher, I'm so glad I can have a leisurely evening with my kids! And it seems to use less water than when I wash dishes with the water running. And most of all, because the dishes are washed well, it protects my wrinkled and aging hands. And because I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I usually use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that too, which was great! Since it's a six-person dishwasher, it easily handles the dishes used by a family of four, so it's spacious enough. It even has enough room for guests! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. Comments (English): [ My new right arm ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks and am leaving a review. I think I run it about twice a day, morning and evening, and I intentionally used it continuously in the beginning.^^----------------------------------------------------------------------------------[Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Open 6-Person Dishwasher] Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM Components: Body + Basket + Cutlery Holder---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Rocket Installation - The technician came to install the product the very next day. They called me early in the morning so I could coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation is really great because you can schedule delivery on any date you want within two weeks of purchase! - The technician installed it very skillfully, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink already had a hole in the top for the water purifier, so I didn't have to drill a separate hole and just ran the hose through the same place. After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual and asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It still works great! Design: I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is important, but if the size and features are similar, I tend to choose the one with the prettiest design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory, and I chose the clean and crisp white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handles are the highlight! It goes so well with my kitchen. The white countertop and wooden door match perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add some flair, and it's still going strong. The cleaning power: "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Will it be okay?" I worried for nothing. Simply put, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes away even the grease. I was so happy to see that even the food on the kids' dishes was washed clean. Various functions - Standard (70 minutes) - Auto (85-130 minutes) - Power (80 minutes) - High-temperature wash (86 minutes) - Rapid (35 minutes) - Various courses are designed to suit your needs, which is convenient. You can choose a course based on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes. Convenience - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially confused by people bringing in dishes during the wash cycle, but the additional function was nice. - The automatic door open function was also really great. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report, and the door would automatically open after the dishwasher was finished, ensuring the dishwasher was still dry. - It says you can connect it to the Media Smart Home app, but I wonder if I'll really use it? I had that thought~ But just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and surprisingly, I ended up using it quite often~ My kids, who aren't very good at operating the dishwasher, or people at home just put their dishes in the dishwasher, and I could start it from outside. By the time I came home from work, ta-da! The dishes were done! Noise: Although this appliance is bound to be noisy, I didn't find it bothersome. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or going out, and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! I can even register it with Coupang and get it repaired~ It's so convenient, worry-free, and the best service. Overall Media: The dishwasher is my right-hand man! After work, I don't have enough time to see my kids, and I always feel like I don't have time to check on their homework, make eye contact, talk, and play because I'm always busy eating, washing dishes, and cleaning up. After meeting this kid, Media Dishwasher, I'm so glad I can have a leisurely evening with my kids! And it seems to use less water than when I wash dishes with the water running. And most of all, because the dishes are washed well, it protects my wrinkled and aging hands. And because I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I usually use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that too, which was great! Since it's a six-person dishwasher, it easily handles the dishes used by a family of four, so it's spacious enough. It even has enough room for guests! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. I was initially confused by people bringing in dishes during the wash cycle, but the additional function was nice. - The automatic door open function was also really great. By the time I came home from work, ta-da! The dishes were done! Noise: Although this appliance is bound to be noisy, I didn't find it bothersome. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or going out, and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! I can even register it with Coupang and get it repaired~ It's so convenient, worry-free, and the best service. Overall Media: The dishwasher is my right-hand man! After meeting this kid, Media Dishwasher, I'm so glad I can have a leisurely evening with my kids! And it seems to use less water than when I wash dishes with the water running. Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. I worried for nothing. Simply put, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes away even the grease. I was so happy to see that even the food on the kids' dishes was washed clean. You can choose a course based on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes. Convenience - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially confused by people bringing in dishes during the wash cycle, but the additional function was nice. - The automatic door open function was also really great. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report, and the door would automatically open after the dishwasher was finished, ensuring the dishwasher was still dry. - It says you can connect it to the Media Smart Home app, but I wonder if I'll really use it? I had that thought~ But just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and surprisingly, I ended up using it quite often~ My kids, who aren't very good at operating the dishwasher, or people at home just put their dishes in the dishwasher, and I could start it from outside. By the time I came home from work, ta-da! The dishes were done! Noise: Although this appliance is bound to be noisy, I didn't find it bothersome. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or going out, and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! I can even register it with Coupang and get it repaired~ It's so convenient, worry-free, and the best service. Overall Media: The dishwasher is my right-hand man! After work, I don't have enough time to see my kids, and I always feel like I don't have time to check on their homework, make eye contact, talk, and play because I'm always busy eating, washing dishes, and cleaning up. After meeting this kid, Media Dishwasher, I'm so glad I can have a leisurely evening with my kids! And it seems to use less water than when I wash dishes with the water running. And most of all, because the dishes are washed well, it protects my wrinkled and aging hands. And because I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I usually use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that too, which was great! Since it's a six-person dishwasher, it easily handles the dishes used by a family of four, so it's spacious enough. It even has enough room for guests! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. Functionality is important, but if the size and features are similar, I tend to choose the one with the prettiest design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add some flair, and it's still going strong. The cleaning power: "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Will it be okay?" I worried for nothing. Simply put, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes away even the grease. I was so happy to see that even the food on the kids' dishes was washed clean. Various functions - Standard (70 minutes) - Auto (85-130 minutes) - Power (80 minutes) - High-temperature wash (86 minutes) - Rapid (35 minutes) - Various courses are designed to suit your needs, which is convenient. You can choose a course based on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes. Convenience - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially confused by people bringing in dishes during the wash cycle, but the additional function was nice. - The automatic door open function was also really great. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report, and the door would automatically open after the dishwasher was finished, ensuring the dishwasher was still dry. - It says you can connect it to the Media Smart Home app, but I wonder if I'll really use it? I had that thought~ But just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and surprisingly, I ended up using it quite often~ My kids, who aren't very good at operating the dishwasher, or people at home just put their dishes in the dishwasher, and I could start it from outside. By the time I came home from work, ta-da! The dishes were done! Noise: Although this appliance is bound to be noisy, I didn't find it bothersome. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or going out, and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! I can even register it with Coupang and get it repaired~ It's so convenient, worry-free, and the best service. Overall Media: The dishwasher is my right-hand man! After work, I don't have enough time to see my kids, and I always feel like I don't have time to check on their homework, make eye contact, talk, and play because I'm always busy eating, washing dishes, and cleaning up. After meeting this kid, Media Dishwasher, I'm so glad I can have a leisurely evening with my kids! And it seems to use less water than when I wash dishes with the water running. And most of all, because the dishes are washed well, it protects my wrinkled and aging hands. And because I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I usually use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that too, which was great! Since it's a six-person dishwasher, it easily handles the dishes used by a family of four, so it's spacious enough. It even has enough room for guests! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones.
