Sentence (English): The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory, and I chose the clean and crisp white!
Comments (English): [ My new right arm ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks and am leaving a review. I think I run it about twice a day, morning and evening, and I intentionally used it continuously in the beginning.^^----------------------------------------------------------------------------------[Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Open 6-Person Dishwasher] Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM Components: Body + Basket + Cutlery Holder---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Rocket Installation - The technician came to install the product the very next day. They called me early in the morning so I could coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation is really great because you can schedule delivery on any date you want within two weeks of purchase! - The technician installed it very skillfully, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink already had a hole in the top for the water purifier, so I didn't have to drill a separate hole and just ran the hose through the same place. After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual and asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It still works great! Design: I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is important, but if the size and features are similar, I tend to choose the one with the prettiest design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory, and I chose the clean and crisp white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handles are the highlight! It goes so well with my kitchen. The white countertop and wooden door match perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add some flair, and it's still going strong. The cleaning power: "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Will it be okay?" I worried for nothing. Simply put, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes away even the grease. I was so happy to see that even the food on the kids' dishes was washed clean. Various functions - Standard (70 minutes) - Auto (85-130 minutes) - Power (80 minutes) - High-temperature wash (86 minutes) - Rapid (35 minutes) - Various courses are designed to suit your needs, which is convenient. You can choose a course based on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes. Convenience - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially confused by people bringing in dishes during the wash cycle, but the additional function was nice. - The automatic door open function was also really great. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report, and the door would automatically open after the dishwasher was finished, ensuring the dishwasher was still dry. - It says you can connect it to the Media Smart Home app, but I wonder if I'll really use it? I had that thought~ But just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and surprisingly, I ended up using it quite often~ My kids, who aren't very good at operating the dishwasher, or people at home just put their dishes in the dishwasher, and I could start it from outside. By the time I came home from work, ta-da! The dishes were done! Noise: Although this appliance is bound to be noisy, I didn't find it bothersome. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or going out, and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! I can even register it with Coupang and get it repaired~ It's so convenient, worry-free, and the best service. Overall Media: The dishwasher is my right-hand man! After work, I don't have enough time to see my kids, and I always feel like I don't have time to check on their homework, make eye contact, talk, and play because I'm always busy eating, washing dishes, and cleaning up. After meeting this kid, Media Dishwasher, I'm so glad I can have a leisurely evening with my kids! And it seems to use less water than when I wash dishes with the water running. And most of all, because the dishes are washed well, it protects my wrinkled and aging hands. And because I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I usually use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that too, which was great! Since it's a six-person dishwasher, it easily handles the dishes used by a family of four, so it's spacious enough. It even has enough room for guests! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! I can even register it with Coupang and get it repaired~ It's so convenient, worry-free, and the best service. Overall Media: The dishwasher is my right-hand man! After work, I don't have enough time to see my kids, and I always feel like I don't have time to check on their homework, make eye contact, talk, and play because I'm always busy eating, washing dishes, and cleaning up. After meeting this kid, Media Dishwasher, I'm so glad I can have a leisurely evening with my kids! And it seems to use less water than when I wash dishes with the water running. And most of all, because the dishes are washed well, it protects my wrinkled and aging hands. And because I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual and asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It still works great! Design: I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is important, but if the size and features are similar, I tend to choose the one with the prettiest design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory, and I chose the clean and crisp white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handles are the highlight! It goes so well with my kitchen. The white countertop and wooden door match perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add some flair, and it's still going strong. The cleaning power: "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Will it be okay?" I worried for nothing. Simply put, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes away even the grease. I was so happy to see that even the food on the kids' dishes was washed clean. Various functions - Standard (70 minutes) - Auto (85-130 minutes) - Power (80 minutes) - High-temperature wash (86 minutes) - Rapid (35 minutes) - Various courses are designed to suit your needs, which is convenient. You can choose a course based on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes. Convenience - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially confused by people bringing in dishes during the wash cycle, but the additional function was nice. - The automatic door open function was also really great. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report, and the door would automatically open after the dishwasher was finished, ensuring the dishwasher was still dry. - It says you can connect it to the Media Smart Home app, but I wonder if I'll really use it? I had that thought~ But just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and surprisingly, I ended up using it quite often~ My kids, who aren't very good at operating the dishwasher, or people at home just put their dishes in the dishwasher, and I could start it from outside. By the time I came home from work, ta-da! The dishes were done! Noise: Although this appliance is bound to be noisy, I didn't find it bothersome. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or going out, and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! I can even register it with Coupang and get it repaired~ It's so convenient, worry-free, and the best service. Overall Media: The dishwasher is my right-hand man! After work, I don't have enough time to see my kids, and I always feel like I don't have time to check on their homework, make eye contact, talk, and play because I'm always busy eating, washing dishes, and cleaning up. After meeting this kid, Media Dishwasher, I'm so glad I can have a leisurely evening with my kids! And it seems to use less water than when I wash dishes with the water running. And most of all, because the dishes are washed well, it protects my wrinkled and aging hands. And because I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I usually use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that too, which was great! Since it's a six-person dishwasher, it easily handles the dishes used by a family of four, so it's spacious enough. It even has enough room for guests! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. Functionality is important, but if the size and features are similar, I tend to choose the one with the prettiest design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add some flair, and it's still going strong. The cleaning power: "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Will it be okay?" I worried for nothing. Simply put, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes away even the grease. I was so happy to see that even the food on the kids' dishes was washed clean. You can choose a course based on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes. Convenience - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially confused by people bringing in dishes during the wash cycle, but the additional function was nice. - The automatic door open function was also really great. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report, and the door would automatically open after the dishwasher was finished, ensuring the dishwasher was still dry. - It says you can connect it to the Media Smart Home app, but I wonder if I'll really use it? I had that thought~ But just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and surprisingly, I ended up using it quite often~ My kids, who aren't very good at operating the dishwasher, or people at home just put their dishes in the dishwasher, and I could start it from outside. By the time I came home from work, ta-da! The dishes were done! Noise: Although this appliance is bound to be noisy, I didn't find it bothersome. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or going out, and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! I can even register it with Coupang and get it repaired~ It's so convenient, worry-free, and the best service. Overall Media: The dishwasher is my right-hand man! After work, I don't have enough time to see my kids, and I always feel like I don't have time to check on their homework, make eye contact, talk, and play because I'm always busy eating, washing dishes, and cleaning up. After meeting this kid, Media Dishwasher, I'm so glad I can have a leisurely evening with my kids! And it seems to use less water than when I wash dishes with the water running. And most of all, because the dishes are washed well, it protects my wrinkled and aging hands. And because I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I usually use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that too, which was great! Since it's a six-person dishwasher, it easily handles the dishes used by a family of four, so it's spacious enough. It even has enough room for guests! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. I worried for nothing. Simply put, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. Convenience - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially confused by people bringing in dishes during the wash cycle, but the additional function was nice. - The automatic door open function was also really great. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report, and the door would automatically open after the dishwasher was finished, ensuring the dishwasher was still dry. - It says you can connect it to the Media Smart Home app, but I wonder if I'll really use it? By the time I came home from work, ta-da! The dishes were done! Noise: Although this appliance is bound to be noisy, I didn't find it bothersome. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or going out, and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! I can even register it with Coupang and get it repaired~ It's so convenient, worry-free, and the best service. Overall Media: The dishwasher is my right-hand man! After work, I don't have enough time to see my kids, and I always feel like I don't have time to check on their homework, make eye contact, talk, and play because I'm always busy eating, washing dishes, and cleaning up. After meeting this kid, Media Dishwasher, I'm so glad I can have a leisurely evening with my kids! And it seems to use less water than when I wash dishes with the water running. And most of all, because the dishes are washed well, it protects my wrinkled and aging hands. And because I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I usually use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that too, which was great! Since it's a six-person dishwasher, it easily handles the dishes used by a family of four, so it's spacious enough. It even has enough room for guests! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. I worried for nothing. Simply put, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. Convenience - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially confused by people bringing in dishes during the wash cycle, but the additional function was nice. - The automatic door open function was also really great. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report, and the door would automatically open after the dishwasher was finished, ensuring the dishwasher was still dry. - It says you can connect it to the Media Smart Home app, but I wonder if I'll really use it? By the time I came home from work, ta-da! The dishes were done! Noise: Although this appliance is bound to be noisy, I didn't find it bothersome. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or going out, and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! I can even register it with Coupang and get it repaired~ It's so convenient, worry-free, and the best service. Overall Media: The dishwasher is my right-hand man! After work, I don't have enough time to see my kids, and I always feel like I don't have time to check on their homework, make eye contact, talk, and play because I'm always busy eating, washing dishes, and cleaning up. After meeting this kid, Media Dishwasher, I'm so glad I can have a leisurely evening with my kids! And it seems to use less water than when I wash dishes with the water running. And most of all, because the dishes are washed well, it protects my wrinkled and aging hands. And because I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I usually use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that too, which was great! Since it's a six-person dishwasher, it easily handles the dishes used by a family of four, so it's spacious enough. It even has enough room for guests! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. I think I run it about twice a day, morning and evening, and I intentionally used it continuously in the beginning.^^----------------------------------------------------------------------------------[Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Open 6-Person Dishwasher] Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM Components: Body + Basket + Cutlery Holder---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Rocket Installation - The technician came to install the product the very next day. After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual and asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It still works great! Design: I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is important, but if the size and features are similar, I tend to choose the one with the prettiest design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory, and I chose the clean and crisp white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handles are the highlight! It goes so well with my kitchen. The white countertop and wooden door match perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add some flair, and it's still going strong. The cleaning power: "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Will it be okay?" I worried for nothing. Simply put, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes away even the grease. I was so happy to see that even the food on the kids' dishes was washed clean. Various functions - Standard (70 minutes) - Auto (85-130 minutes) - Power (80 minutes) - High-temperature wash (86 minutes) - Rapid (35 minutes) - Various courses are designed to suit your needs, which is convenient. You can choose a course based on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes. Convenience - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially confused by people bringing in dishes during the wash cycle, but the additional function was nice. - The automatic door open function was also really great. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report, and the door would automatically open after the dishwasher was finished, ensuring the dishwasher was still dry. - It says you can connect it to the Media Smart Home app, but I wonder if I'll really use it? I had that thought~ But just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and surprisingly, I ended up using it quite often~ My kids, who aren't very good at operating the dishwasher, or people at home just put their dishes in the dishwasher, and I could start it from outside. By the time I came home from work, ta-da! The dishes were done! Noise: Although this appliance is bound to be noisy, I didn't find it bothersome. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or going out, and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! I can even register it with Coupang and get it repaired~ It's so convenient, worry-free, and the best service. Overall Media: The dishwasher is my right-hand man! After work, I don't have enough time to see my kids, and I always feel like I don't have time to check on their homework, make eye contact, talk, and play because I'm always busy eating, washing dishes, and cleaning up. After meeting this kid, Media Dishwasher, I'm so glad I can have a leisurely evening with my kids! And it seems to use less water than when I wash dishes with the water running. And most of all, because the dishes are washed well, it protects my wrinkled and aging hands. And because I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I usually use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that too, which was great! Since it's a six-person dishwasher, it easily handles the dishes used by a family of four, so it's spacious enough. It even has enough room for guests! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. It goes so well with my kitchen. The white countertop and wooden door match perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add some flair, and it's still going strong. The cleaning power: "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Will it be okay?" I worried for nothing. Simply put, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes away even the grease. I was so happy to see that even the food on the kids' dishes was washed clean. Various functions - Standard (70 minutes) - Auto (85-130 minutes) - Power (80 minutes) - High-temperature wash (86 minutes) - Rapid (35 minutes) - Various courses are designed to suit your needs, which is convenient. You can choose a course based on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes. Convenience - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially confused by people bringing in dishes during the wash cycle, but the additional function was nice. - The automatic door open function was also really great. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report, and the door would automatically open after the dishwasher was finished, ensuring the dishwasher was still dry. - It says you can connect it to the Media Smart Home app, but I wonder if I'll really use it? I had that thought~ But just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and surprisingly, I ended up using it quite often~ My kids, who aren't very good at operating the dishwasher, or people at home just put their dishes in the dishwasher, and I could start it from outside. By the time I came home from work, ta-da! The dishes were done! Noise: Although this appliance is bound to be noisy, I didn't find it bothersome. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or going out, and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! I can even register it with Coupang and get it repaired~ It's so convenient, worry-free, and the best service. Overall Media: The dishwasher is my right-hand man! After work, I don't have enough time to see my kids, and I always feel like I don't have time to check on their homework, make eye contact, talk, and play because I'm always busy eating, washing dishes, and cleaning up. After meeting this kid, Media Dishwasher, I'm so glad I can have a leisurely evening with my kids! And it seems to use less water than when I wash dishes with the water running. And most of all, because the dishes are washed well, it protects my wrinkled and aging hands. And because I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I usually use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that too, which was great! Since it's a six-person dishwasher, it easily handles the dishes used by a family of four, so it's spacious enough. It even has enough room for guests! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks and am leaving a review. I think I run it about twice a day, morning and evening, and I intentionally used it continuously in the beginning.^^----------------------------------------------------------------------------------[Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Open 6-Person Dishwasher] Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM Components: Body + Basket + Cutlery Holder---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Rocket Installation - The technician came to install the product the very next day. After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual and asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It still works great! Design: I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is important, but if the size and features are similar, I tend to choose the one with the prettiest design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory, and I chose the clean and crisp white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handles are the highlight! It goes so well with my kitchen. The white countertop and wooden door match perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add some flair, and it's still going strong. The cleaning power: "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Will it be okay?" I worried for nothing. Simply put, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes away even the grease. I was so happy to see that even the food on the kids' dishes was washed clean. Various functions - Standard (70 minutes) - Auto (85-130 minutes) - Power (80 minutes) - High-temperature wash (86 minutes) - Rapid (35 minutes) - Various courses are designed to suit your needs, which is convenient. You can choose a course based on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes. Convenience - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially confused by people bringing in dishes during the wash cycle, but the additional function was nice. - The automatic door open function was also really great. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report, and the door would automatically open after the dishwasher was finished, ensuring the dishwasher was still dry. - It says you can connect it to the Media Smart Home app, but I wonder if I'll really use it? I had that thought~ But just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and surprisingly, I ended up using it quite often~ My kids, who aren't very good at operating the dishwasher, or people at home just put their dishes in the dishwasher, and I could start it from outside. By the time I came home from work, ta-da! The dishes were done! Noise: Although this appliance is bound to be noisy, I didn't find it bothersome. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or going out, and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! I can even register it with Coupang and get it repaired~ It's so convenient, worry-free, and the best service. Overall Media: The dishwasher is my right-hand man! After work, I don't have enough time to see my kids, and I always feel like I don't have time to check on their homework, make eye contact, talk, and play because I'm always busy eating, washing dishes, and cleaning up. After meeting this kid, Media Dishwasher, I'm so glad I can have a leisurely evening with my kids! And it seems to use less water than when I wash dishes with the water running. And most of all, because the dishes are washed well, it protects my wrinkled and aging hands. And because I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I usually use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that too, which was great! Since it's a six-person dishwasher, it easily handles the dishes used by a family of four, so it's spacious enough. It even has enough room for guests! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. I was initially confused by people bringing in dishes during the wash cycle, but the additional function was nice. - The automatic door open function was also really great. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or going out, and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or going out, and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. I was initially confused by people bringing in dishes during the wash cycle, but the additional function was nice. - The automatic door open function was also really great. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or going out, and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual and asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It still works great! Design: I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is important, but if the size and features are similar, I tend to choose the one with the prettiest design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory, and I chose the clean and crisp white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handles are the highlight! It goes so well with my kitchen. The white countertop and wooden door match perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add some flair, and it's still going strong. The cleaning power: "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Will it be okay?" I worried for nothing. Simply put, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes away even the grease. I was so happy to see that even the food on the kids' dishes was washed clean. Various functions - Standard (70 minutes) - Auto (85-130 minutes) - Power (80 minutes) - High-temperature wash (86 minutes) - Rapid (35 minutes) - Various courses are designed to suit your needs, which is convenient. You can choose a course based on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes. Convenience - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially confused by people bringing in dishes during the wash cycle, but the additional function was nice. - The automatic door open function was also really great. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report, and the door would automatically open after the dishwasher was finished, ensuring the dishwasher was still dry. - It says you can connect it to the Media Smart Home app, but I wonder if I'll really use it? I had that thought~ But just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and surprisingly, I ended up using it quite often~ My kids, who aren't very good at operating the dishwasher, or people at home just put their dishes in the dishwasher, and I could start it from outside. By the time I came home from work, ta-da! The dishes were done! Noise: Although this appliance is bound to be noisy, I didn't find it bothersome. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or going out, and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! I can even register it with Coupang and get it repaired~ It's so convenient, worry-free, and the best service. Overall Media: The dishwasher is my right-hand man! After work, I don't have enough time to see my kids, and I always feel like I don't have time to check on their homework, make eye contact, talk, and play because I'm always busy eating, washing dishes, and cleaning up. After meeting this kid, Media Dishwasher, I'm so glad I can have a leisurely evening with my kids! And it seems to use less water than when I wash dishes with the water running. And most of all, because the dishes are washed well, it protects my wrinkled and aging hands. And because I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I usually use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that too, which was great! Since it's a six-person dishwasher, it easily handles the dishes used by a family of four, so it's spacious enough. It even has enough room for guests! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. Comments (English): [ My new right arm ] || ---------------- || This is a review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks and am leaving a review. I think I run it about twice a day, morning and evening, and I intentionally used it continuously in the beginning.^^----------------------------------------------------------------------------------[Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Open 6-Person Dishwasher] Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM Components: Body + Basket + Cutlery Holder---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Rocket Installation - The technician came to install the product the very next day. They called me early in the morning so I could coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation is really great because you can schedule delivery on any date you want within two weeks of purchase! - The technician installed it very skillfully, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink already had a hole in the top for the water purifier, so I didn't have to drill a separate hole and just ran the hose through the same place. After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual and asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It still works great! Design: I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is important, but if the size and features are similar, I tend to choose the one with the prettiest design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory, and I chose the clean and crisp white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handles are the highlight! It goes so well with my kitchen. The white countertop and wooden door match perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add some flair, and it's still going strong. The cleaning power: "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Will it be okay?" I worried for nothing. Simply put, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes away even the grease. I was so happy to see that even the food on the kids' dishes was washed clean. Various functions - Standard (70 minutes) - Auto (85-130 minutes) - Power (80 minutes) - High-temperature wash (86 minutes) - Rapid (35 minutes) - Various courses are designed to suit your needs, which is convenient. You can choose a course based on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes. Convenience - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially confused by people bringing in dishes during the wash cycle, but the additional function was nice. - The automatic door open function was also really great. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report, and the door would automatically open after the dishwasher was finished, ensuring the dishwasher was still dry. - It says you can connect it to the Media Smart Home app, but I wonder if I'll really use it? I had that thought~ But just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and surprisingly, I ended up using it quite often~ My kids, who aren't very good at operating the dishwasher, or people at home just put their dishes in the dishwasher, and I could start it from outside. By the time I came home from work, ta-da! The dishes were done! Noise: Although this appliance is bound to be noisy, I didn't find it bothersome. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or going out, and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! I can even register it with Coupang and get it repaired~ It's so convenient, worry-free, and the best service. Overall Media: The dishwasher is my right-hand man! After work, I don't have enough time to see my kids, and I always feel like I don't have time to check on their homework, make eye contact, talk, and play because I'm always busy eating, washing dishes, and cleaning up. After meeting this kid, Media Dishwasher, I'm so glad I can have a leisurely evening with my kids! And it seems to use less water than when I wash dishes with the water running. And most of all, because the dishes are washed well, it protects my wrinkled and aging hands. And because I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I usually use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that too, which was great! Since it's a six-person dishwasher, it easily handles the dishes used by a family of four, so it's spacious enough. It even has enough room for guests! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks and am leaving a review. I think I run it about twice a day, morning and evening, and I intentionally used it continuously in the beginning.^^----------------------------------------------------------------------------------[Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Open 6-Person Dishwasher] Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM Components: Body + Basket + Cutlery Holder---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Rocket Installation - The technician came to install the product the very next day. Design: I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is important, but if the size and features are similar, I tend to choose the one with the prettiest design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory, and I chose the clean and crisp white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handles are the highlight! It goes so well with my kitchen. The white countertop and wooden door match perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add some flair, and it's still going strong. The cleaning power: "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Will it be okay?" I worried for nothing. Simply put, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes away even the grease. I was so happy to see that even the food on the kids' dishes was washed clean. Various functions - Standard (70 minutes) - Auto (85-130 minutes) - Power (80 minutes) - High-temperature wash (86 minutes) - Rapid (35 minutes) - Various courses are designed to suit your needs, which is convenient. You can choose a course based on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes. Convenience - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially confused by people bringing in dishes during the wash cycle, but the additional function was nice. - The automatic door open function was also really great. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report, and the door would automatically open after the dishwasher was finished, ensuring the dishwasher was still dry. - It says you can connect it to the Media Smart Home app, but I wonder if I'll really use it? I had that thought~ But just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and surprisingly, I ended up using it quite often~ My kids, who aren't very good at operating the dishwasher, or people at home just put their dishes in the dishwasher, and I could start it from outside. By the time I came home from work, ta-da! The dishes were done! Noise: Although this appliance is bound to be noisy, I didn't find it bothersome. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or going out, and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And I think the level of noise varies depending on the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket. After-sales service: Since it's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*, you might be worried about after-sales service. But this product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! I can even register it with Coupang and get it repaired~ It's so convenient, worry-free, and the best service. Overall Media: The dishwasher is my right-hand man! After work, I don't have enough time to see my kids, and I always feel like I don't have time to check on their homework, make eye contact, talk, and play because I'm always busy eating, washing dishes, and cleaning up. After meeting this kid, Media Dishwasher, I'm so glad I can have a leisurely evening with my kids! And it seems to use less water than when I wash dishes with the water running. And most of all, because the dishes are washed well, it protects my wrinkled and aging hands. And because I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I usually use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that too, which was great! Since it's a six-person dishwasher, it easily handles the dishes used by a family of four, so it's spacious enough. It even has enough room for guests! Most of the dishes coming out these days are dishwasher-safe, so it's convenient and nice to be able to use them without having to buy new ones. Comments (English): This review was written after receiving a free dishwasher as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've always wanted to try a dishwasher, and I finally got to! Nothing was more annoying than washing dishes, but this dishwasher was a total revelation! First of all, it seats six people, so while we're newlyweds and don't have a lot of dishes, we do use them frequently, so we had to wash them often. It held plenty, which was great! Also, when I was just washing dishes, I couldn't control the amount of detergent, so I always pumped too much. While it did get the dishes clean, it also used up too quickly. With this dishwasher, you just add a solid detergent and spin it. It's incredibly convenient and great. It also has wide-width washing blades, so you can wash from all directions. Since I usually spin my glassware, I'm not a fan of the high-temperature drying mode. When I was just washing dishes, there was a slight fishy smell from the dishes. That got completely eliminated, so I was able to use them cleanly. And after I was done... The door opens automatically, so the heat generated during high-temperature drying escapes quickly on a tiring day after work. Just put the larvae in and it's done. It's so nice to be able to just turn it on and go to sleep. After using the dishwasher once, I understood why I couldn't live without it. The design is also beautiful. I chose the ivory color. It doesn't detract from my interior at all, and I keep it next to the sink. However, when installing it for the first time, I need a hole for water to drain. Fortunately, my previous owner had already drilled a hole, so I didn't need to drill another one. However, if necessary, I'll have to drill one. They say there may be a small installation fee. The size is also larger than I thought. I don't really care, but if you want a perfect fit, it might be a good idea to buy the right size. Wow, this dishwasher is really great. I've heard it's also app-connected, so I haven't tried it yet. But if I ever have to leave the house, it'll be very convenient.

Comments (English): [ My new right arm ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks now. I've been running it about twice a day, morning and evening. I deliberately used it consistently in the beginning. ^^. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. Components: Body + Basket + Spoon Holder. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Rocket Installation. - The technician came the very next day to install the product. They called me early in the morning to coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation allows you to schedule delivery on your desired date within two weeks of purchase. It's really great because you can! - The technician was very skilled at installing it, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink countertop is already perforated for a water purifier. I didn't drill a separate hole, so I drained the hose from the same location. - After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual for the dishwasher. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is key, but if it's a similar size and features, I tend to choose the one with a pretty design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory. I chose the clean and neat white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handle are the highlight! I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. I deliberately used it consistently in the beginning. ^^. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. Components: Body + Basket + Spoon Holder. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Rocket Installation. - The technician came the very next day to install the product. They called me early in the morning to coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation allows you to schedule delivery on your desired date within two weeks of purchase. It's really great because you can! - The technician was very skilled at installing it, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink countertop is already perforated for a water purifier. I didn't drill a separate hole, so I drained the hose from the same location. - After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual for the dishwasher. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is key, but if it's a similar size and features, I tend to choose the one with a pretty design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory. I chose the clean and neat white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handle are the highlight! I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks now. I've been running it about twice a day, morning and evening. I deliberately used it consistently in the beginning. ^^. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. Components: Body + Basket + Spoon Holder. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Rocket Installation. - The technician came the very next day to install the product. They called me early in the morning to coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation allows you to schedule delivery on your desired date within two weeks of purchase. It's really great because you can! - The technician was very skilled at installing it, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink countertop is already perforated for a water purifier. I didn't drill a separate hole, so I drained the hose from the same location. - After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual for the dishwasher. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is key, but if it's a similar size and features, I tend to choose the one with a pretty design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory. I chose the clean and neat white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handle are the highlight! I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. Comments (English): [ My new right arm ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks now. I've been running it about twice a day, morning and evening. I deliberately used it consistently in the beginning. ^^. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. Components: Body + Basket + Spoon Holder. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Rocket Installation. - The technician came the very next day to install the product. They called me early in the morning to coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation allows you to schedule delivery on your desired date within two weeks of purchase. It's really great because you can! - The technician was very skilled at installing it, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink countertop is already perforated for a water purifier. I didn't drill a separate hole, so I drained the hose from the same location. - After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual for the dishwasher. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is key, but if it's a similar size and features, I tend to choose the one with a pretty design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory. I chose the clean and neat white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handle are the highlight! I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks now. I've been running it about twice a day, morning and evening. I deliberately used it consistently in the beginning. ^^. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. Components: Body + Basket + Spoon Holder. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Rocket Installation. - The technician came the very next day to install the product. They called me early in the morning to coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation allows you to schedule delivery on your desired date within two weeks of purchase. It's really great because you can! - The technician was very skilled at installing it, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink countertop is already perforated for a water purifier. I didn't drill a separate hole, so I drained the hose from the same location. - After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual for the dishwasher. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is key, but if it's a similar size and features, I tend to choose the one with a pretty design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory. I chose the clean and neat white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handle are the highlight! I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher.
