Comments (English): [ My new right arm ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks now. I've been running it about twice a day, morning and evening. I deliberately used it consistently in the beginning. ^^. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. Components: Body + Basket + Spoon Holder. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Rocket Installation. - The technician came the very next day to install the product. They called me early in the morning to coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation allows you to schedule delivery on your desired date within two weeks of purchase. It's really great because you can! - The technician was very skilled at installing it, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink countertop is already perforated for a water purifier. I didn't drill a separate hole, so I drained the hose from the same location. - After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual for the dishwasher. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is key, but if it's a similar size and features, I tend to choose the one with a pretty design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory. I chose the clean and neat white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handle are the highlight! I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. Comments (English): [ My new right arm ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks now. I've been running it about twice a day, morning and evening. I deliberately used it consistently in the beginning. ^^. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. Components: Body + Basket + Spoon Holder. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Rocket Installation. - The technician came the very next day to install the product. They called me early in the morning to coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation allows you to schedule delivery on your desired date within two weeks of purchase. It's really great because you can! - The technician was very skilled at installing it, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink countertop is already perforated for a water purifier. I didn't drill a separate hole, so I drained the hose from the same location. - After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual for the dishwasher. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is key, but if it's a similar size and features, I tend to choose the one with a pretty design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory. I chose the clean and neat white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handle are the highlight! I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is key, but if it's a similar size and features, I tend to choose the one with a pretty design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory. I chose the clean and neat white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handle are the highlight! I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks now. I've been running it about twice a day, morning and evening. I deliberately used it consistently in the beginning. ^^. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. Components: Body + Basket + Spoon Holder. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Rocket Installation. - The technician came the very next day to install the product. They called me early in the morning to coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation allows you to schedule delivery on your desired date within two weeks of purchase. It's really great because you can! - The technician was very skilled at installing it, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink countertop is already perforated for a water purifier. I didn't drill a separate hole, so I drained the hose from the same location. - After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual for the dishwasher. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is key, but if it's a similar size and features, I tend to choose the one with a pretty design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory. I chose the clean and neat white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handle are the highlight! I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks now. I've been running it about twice a day, morning and evening. I deliberately used it consistently in the beginning. ^^. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. Components: Body + Basket + Spoon Holder. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Rocket Installation. - The technician came the very next day to install the product. They called me early in the morning to coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation allows you to schedule delivery on your desired date within two weeks of purchase. It's really great because you can! - The technician was very skilled at installing it, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink countertop is already perforated for a water purifier. I didn't drill a separate hole, so I drained the hose from the same location. - After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual for the dishwasher. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is key, but if it's a similar size and features, I tend to choose the one with a pretty design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory. I chose the clean and neat white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handle are the highlight! I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. Comments (English): [ My new right arm ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks now. I've been running it about twice a day, morning and evening. I deliberately used it consistently in the beginning. ^^. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. Components: Body + Basket + Spoon Holder. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Rocket Installation. - The technician came the very next day to install the product. They called me early in the morning to coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation allows you to schedule delivery on your desired date within two weeks of purchase. It's really great because you can! - The technician was very skilled at installing it, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink countertop is already perforated for a water purifier. I didn't drill a separate hole, so I drained the hose from the same location. - After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual for the dishwasher. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is key, but if it's a similar size and features, I tend to choose the one with a pretty design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory. I chose the clean and neat white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handle are the highlight! I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks now. I've been running it about twice a day, morning and evening. I deliberately used it consistently in the beginning. ^^. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. Components: Body + Basket + Spoon Holder. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Rocket Installation. - The technician came the very next day to install the product. They called me early in the morning to coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation allows you to schedule delivery on your desired date within two weeks of purchase. It's really great because you can! - The technician was very skilled at installing it, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink countertop is already perforated for a water purifier. I didn't drill a separate hole, so I drained the hose from the same location. - After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual for the dishwasher. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is key, but if it's a similar size and features, I tend to choose the one with a pretty design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory. I chose the clean and neat white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handle are the highlight! I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. I deliberately used it consistently in the beginning. ^^. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. Components: Body + Basket + Spoon Holder. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Rocket Installation. - The technician came the very next day to install the product. They called me early in the morning to coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation allows you to schedule delivery on your desired date within two weeks of purchase. It's really great because you can! - The technician was very skilled at installing it, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink countertop is already perforated for a water purifier. I didn't drill a separate hole, so I drained the hose from the same location. - After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual for the dishwasher. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is key, but if it's a similar size and features, I tend to choose the one with a pretty design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory. I chose the clean and neat white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handle are the highlight! I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. Comments (English): [ My new right arm ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks now. I've been running it about twice a day, morning and evening. I deliberately used it consistently in the beginning. ^^. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. Components: Body + Basket + Spoon Holder. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Rocket Installation. - The technician came the very next day to install the product. They called me early in the morning to coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation allows you to schedule delivery on your desired date within two weeks of purchase. It's really great because you can! - The technician was very skilled at installing it, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink countertop is already perforated for a water purifier. I didn't drill a separate hole, so I drained the hose from the same location. - After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual for the dishwasher. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is key, but if it's a similar size and features, I tend to choose the one with a pretty design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory. I chose the clean and neat white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handle are the highlight! I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks now. I've been running it about twice a day, morning and evening. I deliberately used it consistently in the beginning. ^^. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. Components: Body + Basket + Spoon Holder. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Rocket Installation. - The technician came the very next day to install the product. They called me early in the morning to coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation allows you to schedule delivery on your desired date within two weeks of purchase. It's really great because you can! - The technician was very skilled at installing it, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink countertop is already perforated for a water purifier. I didn't drill a separate hole, so I drained the hose from the same location. - After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual for the dishwasher. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is key, but if it's a similar size and features, I tend to choose the one with a pretty design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory. I chose the clean and neat white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handle are the highlight! I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks now. I've been running it about twice a day, morning and evening. I deliberately used it consistently in the beginning. ^^. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. Components: Body + Basket + Spoon Holder. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Rocket Installation. - The technician came the very next day to install the product. They called me early in the morning to coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation allows you to schedule delivery on your desired date within two weeks of purchase. It's really great because you can! - The technician was very skilled at installing it, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink countertop is already perforated for a water purifier. I didn't drill a separate hole, so I drained the hose from the same location. - After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual for the dishwasher. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is key, but if it's a similar size and features, I tend to choose the one with a pretty design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory. I chose the clean and neat white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handle are the highlight! I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks now. I've been running it about twice a day, morning and evening. I deliberately used it consistently in the beginning. ^^. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. Components: Body + Basket + Spoon Holder. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Rocket Installation. - The technician came the very next day to install the product. They called me early in the morning to coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation allows you to schedule delivery on your desired date within two weeks of purchase. It's really great because you can! - The technician was very skilled at installing it, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink countertop is already perforated for a water purifier. I didn't drill a separate hole, so I drained the hose from the same location. - After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual for the dishwasher. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is key, but if it's a similar size and features, I tend to choose the one with a pretty design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory. I chose the clean and neat white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handle are the highlight! I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks now. I've been running it about twice a day, morning and evening. I deliberately used it consistently in the beginning. ^^. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. Components: Body + Basket + Spoon Holder. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Rocket Installation. - The technician came the very next day to install the product. They called me early in the morning to coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation allows you to schedule delivery on your desired date within two weeks of purchase. It's really great because you can! - The technician was very skilled at installing it, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink countertop is already perforated for a water purifier. I didn't drill a separate hole, so I drained the hose from the same location. - After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual for the dishwasher. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is key, but if it's a similar size and features, I tend to choose the one with a pretty design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory. I chose the clean and neat white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handle are the highlight! I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. Comments (English): [ My new right arm ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks now. I've been running it about twice a day, morning and evening. I deliberately used it consistently in the beginning. ^^. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. Components: Body + Basket + Spoon Holder. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Rocket Installation. - The technician came the very next day to install the product. They called me early in the morning to coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation allows you to schedule delivery on your desired date within two weeks of purchase. It's really great because you can! - The technician was very skilled at installing it, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink countertop is already perforated for a water purifier. I didn't drill a separate hole, so I drained the hose from the same location. - After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual for the dishwasher. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is key, but if it's a similar size and features, I tend to choose the one with a pretty design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory. I chose the clean and neat white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handle are the highlight! I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher.
