Comments (English): [ My new right arm ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks now. I've been running it about twice a day, morning and evening. I deliberately used it consistently in the beginning. ^^. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. Components: Body + Basket + Spoon Holder. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Rocket Installation. - The technician came the very next day to install the product. They called me early in the morning to coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation allows you to schedule delivery on your desired date within two weeks of purchase. It's really great because you can! - The technician was very skilled at installing it, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink countertop is already perforated for a water purifier. I didn't drill a separate hole, so I drained the hose from the same location. - After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual for the dishwasher. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is key, but if it's a similar size and features, I tend to choose the one with a pretty design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory. I chose the clean and neat white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handle are the highlight! I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks now. I've been running it about twice a day, morning and evening. I deliberately used it consistently in the beginning. ^^. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. Components: Body + Basket + Spoon Holder. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Rocket Installation. - The technician came the very next day to install the product. They called me early in the morning to coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation allows you to schedule delivery on your desired date within two weeks of purchase. It's really great because you can! - The technician was very skilled at installing it, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink countertop is already perforated for a water purifier. I didn't drill a separate hole, so I drained the hose from the same location. - After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual for the dishwasher. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is key, but if it's a similar size and features, I tend to choose the one with a pretty design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory. I chose the clean and neat white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handle are the highlight! I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks now. I've been running it about twice a day, morning and evening. I deliberately used it consistently in the beginning. ^^. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. Components: Body + Basket + Spoon Holder. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Rocket Installation. - The technician came the very next day to install the product. They called me early in the morning to coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation allows you to schedule delivery on your desired date within two weeks of purchase. It's really great because you can! - The technician was very skilled at installing it, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink countertop is already perforated for a water purifier. I didn't drill a separate hole, so I drained the hose from the same location. - After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual for the dishwasher. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is key, but if it's a similar size and features, I tend to choose the one with a pretty design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory. I chose the clean and neat white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handle are the highlight! I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks now. I've been running it about twice a day, morning and evening. I deliberately used it consistently in the beginning. ^^. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. Components: Body + Basket + Spoon Holder. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Rocket Installation. - The technician came the very next day to install the product. They called me early in the morning to coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation allows you to schedule delivery on your desired date within two weeks of purchase. It's really great because you can! - The technician was very skilled at installing it, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink countertop is already perforated for a water purifier. I didn't drill a separate hole, so I drained the hose from the same location. - After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual for the dishwasher. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is key, but if it's a similar size and features, I tend to choose the one with a pretty design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory. I chose the clean and neat white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handle are the highlight! I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. Comments (English): [ My new right arm ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks now. I've been running it about twice a day, morning and evening. I deliberately used it consistently in the beginning. ^^. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. Components: Body + Basket + Spoon Holder. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Rocket Installation. - The technician came the very next day to install the product. They called me early in the morning to coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation allows you to schedule delivery on your desired date within two weeks of purchase. It's really great because you can! - The technician was very skilled at installing it, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink countertop is already perforated for a water purifier. I didn't drill a separate hole, so I drained the hose from the same location. - After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual for the dishwasher. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is key, but if it's a similar size and features, I tend to choose the one with a pretty design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory. I chose the clean and neat white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handle are the highlight! I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. I've been using the dishwasher for about two weeks now. I've been running it about twice a day, morning and evening. I deliberately used it consistently in the beginning. ^^. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. [Media Countertop App-Linked Automatic Door Opening 6-Person Dishwasher]. Size: W550 X H438 X D515MM. Components: Body + Basket + Spoon Holder. ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------. Rocket Installation. - The technician came the very next day to install the product. They called me early in the morning to coordinate the installation time, which was great because I didn't have to worry about other schedules. - Coupang Rocket Installation allows you to schedule delivery on your desired date within two weeks of purchase. It's really great because you can! - The technician was very skilled at installing it, and it took less than 20 minutes. - My sink countertop is already perforated for a water purifier. I didn't drill a separate hole, so I drained the hose from the same location. - After installation, they gave me a brief instruction manual for the dishwasher. They asked me to wrap toilet paper around the pipes and check for any leaks. It's still going strong! Design. I think I prioritize design over functionality, whether it's furniture or electronics. Functionality is key, but if it's a similar size and features, I tend to choose the one with a pretty design. That's why I fell in love with the Media dishwasher's design and color. The Media 6-person dishwasher comes in two colors: white and ivory. I chose the clean and neat white! The luxurious materials, compact design, and wooden handle are the highlight! I can't believe how well it matches my kitchen. The white countertop matches the wood door perfectly, and I absolutely love it. I added a small item to the already beautiful dishwasher to add a pop of color, and I'm so excited. The cleaning power is amazing. "What if it's just pretty? It's compact. Is that okay?" I was worrying unnecessarily. In short, it washes really well! The wide washing blades thoroughly clean every nook and cranny. My kids always need meat on the table, and the high-temperature wash washes it clean, leaving no trace of grease behind. Even when food dried on the kids' dishes, I was so happy to see it cleaned so well. Various functions: - Standard (70 minutes). - Auto (85-130 minutes). - Power (80 minutes). - High-temperature wash (86 minutes). - Rapid (35 minutes). There are various designed cycles, and it's convenient to be able to choose the right one for your needs. Depending on the type of food you ate that day, the number of dishes you used, and the level of dirt on the dishes, you can choose the right cycle. Convenience. - The ability to add dishes during the wash cycle is one of the best features. I was initially surprised by the number of dishes I brought in during the wash cycle, but the additional functions were great. - The automatic door open function. I also really liked this. I could run the dishwasher, do my chores, and then go out and report. The door automatically opened after it finished, so it was completely dry. - Media Smart Home. It's supposed to be connected to an app. I was skeptical, wondering if I'd actually use it. Still, just in case, I installed the app and connected it, and I ended up using it quite often. Even for kids or people who aren't used to operating the dishwasher, I could simply load the dishes into the dishwasher and have it run from outside. By the time I came home, the dishes were done! Noise. While noisy appliances are inevitable, I didn't find it inconvenient. I usually run the dishwasher while I'm cleaning or out and then do other things, so it didn't bother me. My cats weren't too startled, so I guess this level of noise is okay! And the amount of dishes and how I organize them in the basket seem to affect the level of noise. After-sales service. It's not a well-known brand like Sam* or L*. You might be worried about after-sales service. This product is covered by Coupang's 24-month free after-sales service! You can even get it repaired through Coupang! It's so convenient, worry-free, and the service is top-notch. Overall, the Media dishwasher is my right-hand man! I don't have enough time to spend with my kids after work. Always busy with meals, dishes, and cleanup, I miss their homework. I feel like I don't have enough time to make eye contact, talk, and play. After meeting this Media dishwasher, I really enjoyed spending a relaxing evening with the kids! And it seems like I use less water than when I run the water and do the dishes myself. And most importantly, the dishes are washed well. It also protects my wrinkled, aging hands. I only need to add one tablet of detergent. Since I tend to use a lot of detergent on greasy dishes, I was able to save on that, which was great! It's a six-person dishwasher, so it easily handles the dishes a family of four uses. It even has enough room for guests! Most dishes these days are dishwasher-safe, so I can use them without having to buy new ones. That's also convenient and nice. Aside from the one drawback of the drain pipe being exposed above the sink, I'm very satisfied with this dishwasher. I'm not used to using a rinse aide I don't really like having a film of chemicals on my dishes to dry them and the fill port is hard to pour the liquid in, top on or off. The whirlpool had a gauge you could see to know how much was in as you were filling. I bought a Bosch because of consumer report ratings so only time will tell if it holds up to its ratings.

Sentence (English): We've had Bosch 800 dishwasher for about a month.
Comments (English): [ Pretty good. but missing one vital feature ] || ---------------- || We've had Bosch 800 dishwasher for about a month. It's quiet. It cleans dishes. We're still learning tricks on loading the dishwasher since things like silverware holders that you see in most other dishwashers are replaced with a third rack at the very top of the machine. That works OK but it takes some getting used to. The one silverware basket that is included is super flimsy and small and we use it just for dinner knives since it wouldn't hold much else. The one thing this $1100 machine doesn't have is "Dishes Clean" indicator light. Even base level dishwashers from previous dishwashers had a signal light showing the machine had run thru its cycle and the dishes inside were clean. No such indicator on this Bosch. Yes, we can find a dishwasher clean/dirty magnet but at this price point, that shouldn't be necessary since machines from other makers have this feature in their basic levels models.

Comments (English): [ Not a family dishwasher ] || ---------------- || It is a very nice dishwasher and has a led light to make the dishes appear nicely cleaned. That is about it for the pros. Why bother having basically the same settings if the auto is not going to save you significantly more time and water. Lastly, I'm not sure if this is a me issue only, but the bottom tray does not stay out when loading. It rolls back in. The installers did a good job, but I had to adjust the bottom, and that did not help. It is my wifes biggest issue with the dishwasher.

Sentence (English): If I could give this dishwasher 0 stars, I would.
Comments (English): [ Worst Dishwasher Ever Owned ] || ---------------- || If I could give this dishwasher 0 stars, I would. I had to purchase an ADA compliant dishwasher to fit a slightly smaller than normal opening in our kitchen. This dishwasher is THE WORST! It does not dry, it does not clean, and it's loud. I have to run it at least twice a day for a family of 5 - and I'm still having to hand wash dishes several times a day. While it is slightly smaller than a normal dishwasher, the positioning of the utensil holder makes maximizing the bottom space impossible. It is the worst design I have ever seen. In addition, the cutouts that allow you to place your utensils in the holder are way too small. Half of my utensils and almost all of my kitchen knives and tools do not fit, requiring me to place them on their sides on the top rack - taking up valuable space and resulting in one side not clean. Expect to have to hand dry every single dish you take out as they are never dry. Also plan on rewashing a few things - even with pre-rinsing - as I have yet (after two months) had an entire load come out clean. This dishwasher is WAY overpriced for its performance and functionality. If I were GE, I'd be ashamed to put my company logo on this product. Complete disappointment. Run - don't walk away from this dishwasher.

Sentence (English): I purchased this dishwasher as a replacement.
Comments (English): [ Too soon to know if everything will work for years to come ] || ---------------- || I purchased this dishwasher as a replacement. I also purchased the kit thinking I would need parts. First, the kit was worthless. Water line was too small, by just fractions. I didn't need or use anything the kit supplied; however, I'd opened it so I'm eating the costs associated. The dishwasher arrived in good condition. I immediately went to work installing it by myself. I watched a Utube video and got to work. Although, I wouldn't recommend doing it yourself, unless you're like me, and prefer not to have a stranger in the home doing it his way. Most everything I needed to do was covered in the video, so I ignored the instructions. (Several languages mixed into one confusing mess of a manual.) I got it wired. Attached water lines using the parts from my previous dishwasher. (I don't recommend doing it that way, but the kit left me no choice.) The only part that came with the product was the water hose. I used it. I encountered my only issue with making proper adjustments as I pushed it back under the counter. The attachment parts used to screw it either up under your countertop or to the sides was an hour by itself. Those parts are terrible. I had to use the side screw method, and you have to find screws that are long enough to reach into the cabinet sides, but not with a head large enough to obstruct closing the washer door. The attachment screws are poorly positioned and impossible to complete using the supplied screws. I found what I needed after several tries. The dishwasher fired up and I am now running its first test wash. No leaks thus far; however, I'm concerned the side screw method will eventually loosen or leak since I had to modify how it attached. If you're using the upper countertop attachment you should be fine. My only complaint about the washer was the handle itself. Each end has a RED end cap. Not sure what that's about. Takes away from the stainless look.

Sentence (English): Trust me and please DO NOT waste your money on this dishwasher!
Comments (English): [ poor quality and customer service ] || ---------------- || Trust me and please DO NOT waste your money on this dishwasher! I have owned this dishwasher for just under a year. I purchased it because it had the features I wanted, a high rating and reviews seemed to reflect satisfied customers. I should have dug a little deeper. The "stainless steel" door is not really stainless steel and it has a clear plastic coating on it that is peeling off. Why is it peeling off? Because exterior door is severely RUSTING all along the bottom. The "stainless" interior is also rusting in multiple spots on the inner door, ALL the drawer glides, the walls, the top and the bottom. I followed all the care and cleaning instructions that came with the dishwasher. I contacted KitchenAid within the one year warranty and after waiting for 30 minutes I explained the issue to customer service. They said they had to send a repair service to my home to see the problem. The polite gentleman from the repair service came to my home, looked at the all the rust and peeling and told me it was NOT under warranty as it was cosmetic! I emailed KitchenAid that this was unacceptable and I would like someone to contact me ASAP to explain to me why they are not standing behind an obviously defective product, it has been over a week and I have still not received a response! After searching online and reading multiple reviews at other sites, I see that KitchenAid is well aware about this rusting and peeling issue with their "stainless" dishwashers and continues to sell them! I have yet to see a review that says KitchenAid did the right thing and refunded or replaced the dishwasher. This is not a cosmetic issue, this is false advertising and horrible quality materials from a company that does not stand behind their products.

Sentence (English): Before moving in, I had to coordinate with the interior construction company, so I changed the order and delivery date several times, but they installed it on time.
Comments (English): [ I understand why everyone is telling me to buy it. ] || ---------------- || Before moving in, I had to coordinate with the interior construction company, so I changed the order and delivery date several times, but they installed it on time. My own review =================================== This is the first time I bought a large appliance online. I always went to the dealer to buy it, so I'm a country bumpkin. I never thought it would be this easy to buy online! On top of that, I got an additional card discount, so honestly, the price difference between the official website and the dealer was too big. I hesitated for a moment because the 14-person model was newly released, but it was almost twice the price of the 12-person model. Everyone around me advised me not to be greedy because the 12-person model was enough~ I chose the model with hot air drying. My kids are in elementary school, but they get sick often and are hospitalized often. Since there's a kid who insists on carrying a spoon (he doesn't want to use the spoons given by school), I'm still using a bottle sterilizer at home. Now, I wanted to get rid of the sterilizer. Haha;;; A simple meal for a family of three without a husband and children is only done in the upper compartment. Even if you cook the main dish, it doesn’t take up that much space, so it seems like 12 people are enough for a family of four. The picture was taken when I was using the upper compartment. (There are no dishes in the lower compartment) I’m still a dishwasher beginner, so I don’t have the skills to play Tetris with the dishes, but I just roughly put them in like that. It says not to put plastic in, but it was okay to put in baby bottles and tapioca. Oh. Before that, let’s wash the dishes? I roughly rinsed and put in rice and red pepper powder! If you select the upper compartment and start, it will take a little over 2 hours, and this includes the hot air drying time. After washing and drying, the door opens slightly (for models that don’t have hot air drying, this is the end point). Hot air drying starts for about an hour from here. If you don’t want to do hot air drying, you can cancel it here, but I bought it just for this. I didn’t cancel it~ The music starts and everything is done. After washing the dishes, I take a break~ Why do people say to buy it no matter what? You have to use it to know for sure! If I'm going to wash them first, I'll just wash them~ You might think that, but the dishes I washed in the dishwasher are much better than those I washed by hand. The dishes are shiny~ Even washing the dishes first is done by just scrubbing them with a stick brush, so it's actually not that difficult. I should've bought it a long time ago. It's so so good^^ The end.
Comments (Original): [ 왜 다들 사라고 하는지 알겠어요 ] || ---------------- || 이사 들어가기 전에 인테리어 공사랑 스케줄을 맞추다 보니, 주문하고 배송일자를 몇번 변경했었는데도 날짜 잘 맞춰서 설치 해주셨습니다. ✔️ 내돈내산 후기 ================================ 살면서 대형가전은 인터넷으로 구매한게 처음 입니다. 항상 대리점에 가서 구매했었던  저는 촌스러운 아줌마..ㅋㅋ  인터넷으로 이렇게 쉽게 구매할 줄이야! 게다가 카드 추가할인까지 받으니, 공홈이랑 대리점 포함하여  솔직히 가격차이가 너무 많이 났어요. 14인용이 새로 출시되었길래 잠시 고민했는데 12인용과는 가격이 거의 2배차이.. 주변에서 다들 12인용도 충분하니까 욕심 낼 필요 없다고 조언을 받았고~ 모델은 무조건 열풍건조 되는걸로 선택했어요. 아이들이 초딩이지만 워낙 자주 아프고 입원도 자주 하니... 굳이 수저까지 챙겨서 다니려는 녀석이 있어서 (학교에서 주는 수저는 쓰기 싫답니다..ㅠㅠ) 집에서는 젖병소독기를 아직 사용하고 있거든요. 이젠 좀 소독기를 치우고 싶었..하하;;; 신랑없이 아이들과 간단히 먹는  3식구의 식사는 상칸 한층만 돌리게 됩니다. 메인요리를 하더라도 그리 꽉 차지는 않아서 4식구 살림에 12인용도 충분히 여유있는것 같습니다. 사진은 상칸집중으로 돌릴때 찍었어요. (하칸은 그릇 없음) 아직 식세기초보라서  그릇을 잘 테트리스 하는 기술은 없습니다만, 그냥 적당히 저렇게 대충 넣었어요. 플라스틱은 넣으면 안된다는데, 젖병소재 물병이랑 타파껀 그냥 넣어도 괜찮았어요.  아..그전에 애벌설거지?? 밥풀이나 고춧가루 같은건 대충 헹궈내고 넣었구요! 상칸집중으로 선택해서 시작하면 2시간 좀 넘게 나오는데, 열풍건조 시간 포함된 시간입니다.  세척후 건조되면 문이 빼꼼히 열리고요, (열풍건조 안되는 모델은 여기서 끝.) 여기서부터 열풍건조가 약 1시간 가량 시작됩니다. 열풍건조 하기 싫으면  여기서 취소시키면 되는데, 저는 이거 하려고 산거라..취소 안하고요~ 음악소리 나고 모두다 완료됨. 식세기 돌리고 나는 휴식을 취하고~ 왜 다들 무조건 사라고 하는지... 이건 무조건 써봐야 안다는 거!!! 에벌세척 할꺼면 그냥 설거지 하고 말지~ 생각 하겠지만... 식세기 돌린 그릇이 내손으로 씻은 것보다 훨씬 잘 씻깁니다..그릇에서 윤이 나요~  애벌설거지도 스틱으로 된 솔로 쉭쉭~문지르면 끝이라서 사실 어렵지도 않고요.. 진작에 샀어야 하는데... 너무너무 좋습니다^^ 끝.

I never thought it would be this easy to buy online! On top of that, I got an additional card discount, so honestly, the price difference between the official website and the dealer was too big. I hesitated for a moment because the 14-person model was newly released, but it was almost twice the price of the 12-person model. Sentence (English): I bought a dishwasher due to moving.
Comments (English): [ LG Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I bought a dishwasher due to moving. It was installed on the desired date without any difficulties - Coupang purchase, LG installation - Cheaper when comparing prices - Delivery on the desired date - Reform immediately upon installation (choose to demolish or reuse sink) I was able to find some differences with my second purchase of the dishwasher. - Power button The power button used to be on the top, so I had to press it before closing the dishwasher door, but the operation button has moved to the front, making it more convenient. - Knife storage box There was a concern that the cutlery could be placed next to the spoon when washing the knives, but the knife storage section was now at the very bottom. - Increased time required And it was 55 minutes for normal washing, but it increased to 2 hours and 59 minutes for 1-hour washing and normal washing. There is no difficulty using the 1-hour washing for simple washing. - More types of product end sounds The end sound that is played after washing used to be the same, so it was sometimes confused with other electronic products, but now there are more types of end sounds, so it is less likely to be confused with other products, and the songs are fun. People around me said that dishwashers are better than dryers, so I really wanted to try it out :) There were also many times when I felt lazy about washing dishes! Before buying a dishwasher, I visited several offline stores and searched and looked online, but I decided on a 14-person model because I thought the dishwasher was the best. I also decided on the latest model that has hot air drying. I bought it before moving and set the desired delivery date in advance. The installer contacted me before visiting and came to install it! The installer installed it quickly and kindly explained how to use it :) The color of the lower sink in my house is gray, so I really liked the beige color that went well with it! The design is neat and the color is really pretty! After using it, I feel like it washes much more cleanly and squeakily than when I do it by hand. With the 100-degree True Steam and Tornado cleaning blades, especially the grease is washed away very well. After washing, the door opens automatically and dries with hot air, so I can run the dishwasher before going to bed with peace of mind. It puts in a lot of dishes, but since we are a family of two, when there isn't much to wash, I run it with the designated download course. The download course is set to run only the upper cabinets. You can set the download course as you like in the LG ThinQ app, so be sure to use it! And when you don't have time, I think running it in 1-hour mode is enough! You can use it with more peace of mind because you get a notification when it starts and ends with the LG ThinQ app. It's a really smart world~ Before purchasing, you should definitely check whether there is a place for the dishwasher, and also check how high the mop holder is! Otherwise, you may have to cut the mop holder. When buying one or two electronic devices, the internet is the cheapest, so if you're looking to buy a dishwasher, go to Coupang! I highly recommend it! - If you found my review helpful, please click the Helpful button! :)

Sentence (English): I'm giving it extra stars on purpose.
Comments (English): [ Change the company that does the sink work, LG. ] || ---------------- || I'm giving it extra stars on purpose. In reality, it's not even worth a star. After the sink was renovated, the silicone wasn't even dry when they came and put it in and all the silicone came off. That's okay, but that's understandable. The furniture company said they'd come back and do it, but I was working at the company, missed a meeting, left early, and came home. The person who did the sink furniture came twice, so I don't know if it was because they were lazy, but they just roughly sprayed the silicone and left (they didn't even ask me to check). After they left, I noticed that they only did the front and the sides were still messy and hadn't been redone. I contacted them right away and they came back. They did it again and told me to check, but one side wasn't properly done, so the space where the silicone should be was empty. When I asked if there was silicone, they said it was done. When I looked again and said it wasn't, they said it wasn't, and they seemed to be surprised and asked me to do all the parts other than the part where the dishwasher goes in. That's not it. They told me to look here and took a picture to show me, and when I said, "Oh, if you look there, you can see that place," they said something like that and applied silicone to the empty area again, but they made a huge mess and covered it up here and there. I got so angry after doing this. It was a dishwasher that I put in when I moved into a new apartment, but because of that, there was silicone all over the sink. They did this and charged me 50,000 won for sink reinforcement work. The more I touched it, the more the silicone spread out, so I didn't like it, but I told them to leave. I complained to the construction company and am waiting. - Review The sink construction site came back the next day and tried their best to make it look nice again. It's not as clean as the first time because it's already been cleaned. I think it's because of the review, but LG contacted me. The technician was very kind, but I'm very sorry to have to write this because of the subcontractor who did the sink construction. The product itself is very good. I used a Samsung dishwasher before, but I clean it better and there are no water stains, so I'm very satisfied with the dishwasher itself. Five stars. It must be because I was unlucky. Other people will be able to install it well.

Sentence (English): I considered buying it for about a month, and I'm very satisfied.
Comments (English): I considered buying it for about a month, and I'm very satisfied. My biggest concern was whether I'd have to buy a separate water tank if it got dirty. Since it's dishwashing water, it had to be clean, right? Fortunately, the water tank can be removed and cleaned, so I bought it without hesitation. Now that I've bought it, I regret not buying it sooner. I read in some reviews that Minix dishwasher detergent was included as a sample, but it wasn't. That's why I had to buy it separately, which delayed my review. I even cut the mini tablet detergent for six people in half, and it's more than enough. It washes the dishes clean. It takes a long time to dry, but it's nice to be able to sit at the table and enjoy a cup of coffee after the dishwasher has been running. I registered it on the Minix website and signed up for the Ansim Care Insurance, which gives me peace of mind. Thank you for making such a great product. I hope you sell well and prosper.
Comments (Original): 한 달 정도 고민하고 구입했는데 매우 만족합니다. 가장 고민했던 것은 물통 안에 물때가 끼면 물통을 다시 따로 구입해야하는지 여부였습니다. 설거지 물이니 깨끗해야 하잖아요. 다행히 물통을 분리해서 내부 세척을 할 수 있더라고요. 그래서 고민없이 구매했고요. 사고나니 진작 살 걸 후회가 될 정도입니다. 미닉스 식세기 세제를 샘플로 준다고 몇몇 리뷰에서 읽었는데 없더라고요. 그래서 세제를 따로 구입하느라 리뷰 작성이  늦었습니다. 요즘 나오는 6인용 미니 태블릿 세제를 절반으로 잘라 써도 충분하네요. 깨끗하게 닦입니다. 설거지에 건조까지 시간이 오래 걸리지만 식세기 돌려놓고 식탁에 앉아 커피 마시는 여유가 있어서 좋네요. 미닉스 홈페이지에 정품 등록하고 안심케어보험도 신청하니 안심이 됩니다. 좋은 제품 만들어주셔서 감사하네요. 많이 파시고 번창하십시오.

Sentence (English): I agonized over choosing between the 12-place and 6-place models.
Comments (English): [ I like it so much ] || ---------------- || I agonized over choosing between the 12-place and 6-place models. Even within the 6-place models, I spent a long time researching the interior before making my decision. When I saw people using 12-place models, their sinks looked incredibly messy. Seeing the dishes piled up with the intention of cleaning them all at once, covered in grease and looking dirty, I wondered if I really needed to use one if it meant going through all that trouble. I was someone who didn't feel the need for a dishwasher before. However, the conclusion is that it is definitely a good choice. Size was a major factor; I searched specifically for models that open from both the top and bottom, and after narrowing down my options, I focused mainly on Panasonic, LG, and Samsung. Since the width of my sink is 54cm, I couldn't place it facing forward. I even considered getting a 2-3 place model. I agonized over this decision immensely. I also visited various homes and looked at the S* Magic (since their model had stainless steel all the way to the ceiling), and while I liked it, it was discontinued. After searching for a long time, I saw posts saying that S*Magic was selling relabeled Media products and that Coupang was now importing them directly at no markup prices. When I saw all these posts, they looked exactly the same. So I searched again right away and bought one. Considering the electricity and water bills, the 6-person capacity is a perfect fit for me (a family of three). I carefully measured the dimensions and took the door opening into account, and installed it right next to the sink by a hair's breadth. It looks exactly like I wanted. I don't like having things piled up, so I don't feel cheated(?) even if I use it right away. If the amount is small, I can gather it up and run it, or it's just so good. I was really angry that the price dropped right after I bought it, but I am happy because I am satisfied with everything else. It has a door opening function, so it is really convenient to run it before leaving. I am happy.

Sentence (English): I really didn't plan on buying it because YouTuber Guigom said it was so bad.
Comments (English): I really didn't plan on buying it because YouTuber Guigom said it was so bad. I went to experience the refresh room a while ago and got my hands on the dishwasher and bought it right away. The one I used before was the discontinued SK Magic 6-person, but it was so hard to open and close the door. The design wasn't pretty either. But this one is really easy to open and close because you just have to press the button. And the important thing is that it's so pretty. Also! It can hold more dishes than the SK one. Sentence (English): Bosch 500 DishwasherSummary: it is a good dishwasher but buy the 300 model as it is virtually identical to the 500 model but $200 cheaper.
Comments (English): [ Useless features while missing useful ones ] || ---------------- || Bosch 500 DishwasherSummary: it is a good dishwasher but buy the 300 model as it is virtually identical to the 500 model but $200 cheaper. The only functional difference I could find between the 300 and 500 is the 500 has more wash choices (needed why? ). Other differences include the 3rd rack, which can be adjusted on the 500, both have delay timer but it is a simple button on the 300 while on the 500 you must use the app; Finally , the biggest difference is front display (good! ) on the 300 vs top display on the 500. Neither have auto dry despite advertising from Bosch that a big difference between the 500 and 300 is auto dry (what they don't say is "not all 500 models").Dislikes:-Auto air dry isn't present on this model even though Bosch advertises this is a feature of the 500 series;-When closing, the door slams shut, a future problem for sure;-No delay start function except via app;-Utility rack doesn't keep silverware upright;-Tongs on lower rack immobile, too skinny and directional not good;-Upper rack wine glass holder not very well oriented so wine glasses take up alot of space yet the space under the glass is too tight to fit anything, even small cups;-Upper rack non-wine glass side are too wide for most glasses so they flop around, yet the skinny row is too close for any glasses;-For reasons I haven't figured out yet, pots don't really fit in this dishwasher… to tight tongs? Not wide enough on bottom? -To put pots in the top rack, you need to lower it and then dinner plates don't fit in the bottom rack (desert plates still fit);-Same problem happens when you put wine glasses on top rack;-I put hand mixer beaters in bottom rack, blade up and they didn't get clean, put them in a second time the same way and they still came out dirty, a third time I put the in upside down but got the same dirty result. They cleaned easily by sponge.-Same result when I put the meat lifter fork in the dishwasher… out dirty, apparently too skinny to clean! ;-Upper rack I put small cups in the middle and … you guessed it, they came out dirty. The middle assembly of the top rack is a bit large, blocking complete cleaning of small cups that straddle it! -When I open the DW in the morning, the DW is still warm and humid (8h later, must be insulated really well! ), even if dishes are mostly dry;-Finish not fingerprint resistant;Likes:-Orientation of the tongs does a great job of fitting lots of dishes upright with no tilt, and wide spaced tongs are great for higher rimmed plates while the skinny spaced tongs nicely hold low rimmed dishes;-Quiet;-Cleans very well (upper rack and small and skinny stuff aside);-Lots of wash choices (though I haven't figured out why I need more than quick, regular and heavy);-Has a sanitize nice feature I might someday use, though i can't figure out why now;-The detergent dispenser is near the top of the door, thus it doesn't get soaked with dripping from the upper rack when loading. It's also easier to get to than those located near the bottom of the door.Undecided:-Dry…auto air dry aside, it seems to dry dishes efficiently, though if I'm around when it finishes and open the door a bit (which auto open was supposed to do), drying is complete. If I don't open the door at the end, dishes are dry but the dishwasher is damp;I ended up returning it and buying the 300, which as I said, is almost identical. So it has many of the same issues with glasses falling over because spaces are too large etc, but I like being able to shut it (still slams) and turn it on (without the app! ).
